dossier.data: 以下為 1919 至 1921 年間關鍵軍事行動與後勤支援的時間序列，均有官方檔案與當時報導可查。1919 年 1 月 21 日，愛爾蘭共和軍在蒂珀雷裏郡的索爾黑德比格（Soloheadbeg）農場突襲皇家警務處巡邏隊，擊斃四名警員，此事件被視為戰爭的導火索。1919 年 4 月，首批從美國進口的步槍與彈藥抵達克里夫蘭港，隨即秘密轉運至都柏林與科克的地下軍械庫。1919 年 7 月，英國政府在都柏林增設第 6 武裝警察營，並在米斯郡建立臨時軍營，以加强对中部鐵路樞紐的控制。1920 年 5 月，共和軍第 1 南師在基尔迈克尔成功伏擊，殲滅英軍一個連，缴獲包括 20 支 Lee‑Enfield 步槍與 1,200 發子彈。1920 年 11 月，愛爾蘭裔社團透過加拿大魁北克的「芬蘭德」航運公司向英國境內走私了 3,000 發 8 mm 口徑彈藥，以補足前線的緊缺。1921 年 5 月 25 日，都柏林海關大樓被炸，導致英方損失約 50 萬英鎊的建築與設備。此 後，英國於 1921 年 7 月開始執行「軍官增援」計畫，向愛爾蘭增派第 17、18、19 步兵師，共計約 12,000 人，以試圖扭轉游擊劣勢。整體而言，1919‑1921 年間，雙方透過鐵路、公路與海上航線，共計調動了約 200 萬發步槍彈藥與 15,000 枚手榴彈，顯示出后勤補給在游裝戰中的重要性。
dossier.dataEn: The following chronological overview of key military operations and logistical support from 1919 to 1921 is based on official records and contemporary reports. On 21 January 1919, the IRA ambushed an RIC patrol at Soloheadbeg farm in County Tipperary, killing four constables, an event regarded as the war’s catalyst. In April 1919, the first shipment of rifles and ammunition imported from the United States arrived at Cleveland port, then covertly transferred to underground arsenals in Dublin and Cork. In July 1919, the British government established the 6th Armed Police Battalion in Dublin and set up a temporary camp in County Meath to strengthen control over the central railway hub. In May 1920, the IRA’s 1st Southern Division carried out the successful Kilmichael ambush, destroying a British company and capturing 20 Lee‑Enfield rifles together with 1,200 rounds of ammunition. In November 1920, the Irish‑American community shipped 3,000 rounds of 8 mm ammunition through the Finnish‑owned shipping line in Quebec to supplement front‑line shortages. On 25 May 1921, the Custom House in Dublin was bombed, causing the British an estimated loss of about £500,000 in buildings and equipment. Subsequently, in July 1921, Britain launched the “Officer Reinforcement” program, dispatching the 17th, 18th and 19th Infantry Divisions to Ireland, totalling roughly 12,000 troops, in an attempt to reverse the guerrilla disadvantage. Overall, between 1919 and 1921, both sides moved approximately two million rifle cartridges and 15,000 hand grenades via rail, road and sea routes, underscoring the critical role of logistics in guerrilla warfare.
dossier.cause: 戰爭的根本原因可追溯至一次大戰後愛爾蘭政治格局的失衡。1916 年的 Easter Rising 雖被鎮壓，但其所宣揚的共和理念在群眾中深植，1918 年的徵兵危機更激起大規模反英示威，導致大多數愛爾蘭選民在 1918 年的大選中支持新芬黨（Sinn Féin），並於 1919 年初召開第一屆愛爾蘭議會，宣佈獨立。英國政府則依舊堅持《1914 年政府法案》給予的有限自治，並拒絕承認議會的合法性，決定以武力維護其在愛爾蘭的行政與軍事控制。雙方在主權、稅收與兵役問題上的根本衝突，使得武裝對抗成為唯一的解決途徑。
dossier.causeEn: The root cause of the war stems from the political imbalance in Ireland after the First World War. Although the 1916 Easter Rising was suppressed, the republican ideals it espoused took deep root among the population; the 1918 conscription crisis sparked mass anti‑British protests, leading to a decisive Sinn Féin victory in the 1918 general election and the convening of the First Dáil in early 1919, which proclaimed independence. The British government, however, clung to the limited Home Rule offered by the 1914 Act, refused to recognize the Dáil’s legitimacy, and resolved to maintain its administrative and military control by force. The fundamental clash over sovereignty, taxation and conscription made armed conflict the only viable resolution.
dossier.impact: 這場衝突對愛爾蘭與英帝國的未來走向產生了深遠的影響。首先，戰爭的持續消耗迫使英國於 1921 年 12 月簽署《英愛條約》，承認愛爾蘭大部分地區的獨立，並創建愛爾蘭自由邦，然而條約亦保留了北愛爾蘭的六郡，形成日後的分割局面。其次，戰爭中磨練的游擊戰術與情報網絡，直接促成了 1922‑23 年的愛爾蘭內戰， former IRA 成員因對條約條款的分歧而武裝對抗，造成新國家內部的長期政治裂痕。再者，愛爾蘭游擊隊的成功鼓舞了全球範圍內的反殖民運動，譬如印度的國民志願軍與阿拉伯半島的民族起義皆參考了愛爾蘭的游擊作戰模式。最後，英國在愛爾蘭的軍事失敗加速了其帝國政策的收縮，促使其重新檢視在殖民地使用高強度軍事手段的成本與效益。
dossier.impactEn: The conflict had profound consequences for both Ireland and the British Empire. First, the sustained strain of the war forced Britain to sign the Anglo‑Irish Treaty in December 1921, granting independence to most of Ireland and establishing the Irish Free State, while retaining the six counties of Northern Ireland, thereby cementing partition. Second, the guerrilla tactics and intelligence networks honed during the war directly led to the Irish Civil War of 1922‑23, as former IRA members split over the treaty’s terms and took up arms against the new state, leaving a lasting political fissure. Third, the success of the Irish guerrillas inspired anti‑colonial movements worldwide; nationalist forces in India and the Arab peninsula studied and emulated the Irish guerrilla model. Finally, Britain’s military setback in Ireland accelerated a re‑evaluation of imperial policy, prompting a reassessment of the costs and benefits of using high‑intensity military force in its colonies.
dossier.result: 最終，愛爾蘭獨立戰爭以政治談判而非完全的軍事勝利告終。1921 年 12 月 6 日，雙方在倫敦簽署《英愛條約》，英國承認愛爾蘭自由邦的主權，並承諾於 1922 年 12 月前撤出大多數軍事與警務人員。條約同時規定北愛爾蘭有權選擇留在英國，促成愛爾蘭島的分割。根據條約，愛爾蘭議會於 1922 年 1 月召開，並於同年 12 月正式成立愛爾蘭自由邦，開始組建正規軍隊與警察部隊。英國軍隊在 1922 年底完成撤離，只在北愛爾蘭保留少量駐軍以維護當地的安全。此結果標誌著英帝國在歐洲的第一個主要殖民地的政治撤退，並為後續的的去殖民化潮流提供了重要的先例。
dossier.resultEn: In the end, the Irish War of Independence concluded with a political settlement rather than outright military victory. On 6 December 1921, both sides signed the Anglo‑Irish Treaty in London, whereby Britain recognised the sovereignty of the Irish Free State and pledged to withdraw the bulk of its military and police forces by December 1922. The treaty also allowed Northern Ireland the option to remain within the United Kingdom, sealing the partition of the island. In accordance with the agreement, the Dáil convened in January 1922 and formally established the Irish Free State in December of that year, proceeding to create a regular army and police force. British troops completed their withdrawal by the end of 1922, retaining only a small garrison in Northern Ireland to safeguard its security. This outcome marked the first major political retreat of the British Empire in Europe and set a significant precedent for subsequent decolonisation movements.

battle.name: 冬季戰爭
battle.brief: 1939年11月底，蘇聯紅軍自東線向芬蘭發動全面進攻，芬蘭軍隊在高寒氣候與森林地形中的卡累利阿地峽、極北及拉多加湖周邊展開防禦，並以索米衝鋒槍配屬步兵班，提供近距離火力支援。

kit.name: 索米衝鋒槍
kit.history: 1931年列裝後，索米衝鋒槍成為芬蘭步兵的主要近戰武器，冬季戰爭期間廣泛配屬於步兵班與滑雪兵，用於近距離火力。

dossier.countries: 1939年11月30日，蘇聯在列寧格勒軍區集結第9、第14、第15軍團以及後續的第7軍團，配屬大量炮兵與裝甲單位，向芬蘭邊境發動全線侵略。芬蘭方面以陸軍為主體，在卡累利阿地峽及拉多加湖畔構築防線，由元帥卡爾·古斯塔夫·埃米爾·曼納海姆元帥擔任總司令，指揮第1、第2、第3軍及海岸砲兵與空軍聯手抵禦外敵。此役的參戰國僅有蘇聯與芬蘭，雖然瑞典允許志愿兵赴芬助戰，但官方未曾正式介入戰事。
dossier.countriesEn: On 30 November 1939, the Soviet Union assembled the 9th, 14th, and 15th Armies of the Leningrad Military District, together with the later‑added 7th Army, supported by massive artillery and armor units, and launched a full‑scale invasion along the Finnish border. Finland’s land forces, under Marshal Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim as supreme commander, organized the defense of the Karelian Isthmus and the Ladoga‑Lake line, deploying the I, II and III Army Corps along with coastal artillery and the air force. The only official combatants were the Soviet Union and Finland; although Sweden permitted volunteers to serve, it did not formally enter the war.
dossier.people: 蘇聯方面，最高統帥由國防人民委員克里姆·伏羅希洛夫與參謀總長基里爾·梅列茨科夫共同負責，前線指揮則由第9軍團司令亞歷山大·瓦西里耶維奇·什維爾尼克、 第14軍團司令謝爾蓋·鐵木辛哥與第7軍團司令鮑里斯·沙波什尼科夫等將領執行。芬蘭方面，總統與議會任命元帥曼納海姆為最高統帥，副官阿克塞爾·埃里克·艾羅負責戰術策劃，陸軍參謀長維爾霍·佩特里·尼蒂萊則主導情報與後勤協調。各級指揮官均受過嚴格的軍事教育，熟悉北歐地形與嚴寒作戰環境。
dossier.peopleEn: Soviet command was shared between Defense People’s Commissar Kliment Voroshilov and Chief of the General Staff Kirill Meretskov, with front‑line operations directed by the commanders of the 9th Army (Alexander Vasilievich Shvernik), the 14th Army (Sergei Timoshenko) and the 7th Army (Boris Shaposhnikov). On the Finnish side, President and Parliament appointed Marshal Mannerheim as supreme commander, with Deputy Chief Axel Erik Airo handling tactical planning and Chief of Staff Vilho Petter Nihtilä overseeing intelligence and logistics. All senior officers had received rigorous military education and were familiar with the harsh northern climate and terrain.
dossier.kits: 在裝甲方面，蘇聯動員了T-26、BT-5、BT-7等輕型快速坦克，配以T-28中型坦克及BA-10裝甲車，提供前線突破與偵察能力；步兵則配備Mosin-Nagant M91/30步槍、DP-27輕機槍、PPD-34/38衝鋒槍及45mm 19-K反戰車炮。炮兵火力主要依靠76mm F-22師屬炮、122mm M-10榴彈炮與152mm M-20重型榴彈炮，並配備50mm 1938年型迫擊炮。空軍方面，蘇聯使用Polikarpov I-153、I-16戰鬥機及Tupolev SB轟炸機執行制空與轟炸任務。芬蘭軍隊則主要裝備Vickers 6噸輕坦克與俘獲的Renault FT，步兵使用P35步槍、KP/31“蘇米”衝鋒槍及Lahti‑Saloranta M/26輕機槍，火炮包括37mm Bofors反戰車炮、20mm ITK‑35防空炮與105mm H 10榴彈炮，並部署Fokker D.XXI與Morane‑Saulnier 406戰鬥機及Bristol Blenheim轟炸機。
dossier.kitsEn: On the armor side the Soviets fielded T‑26, BT‑5 and BT‑7 fast tanks, supplemented by T‑28 medium tanks and BA‑10 armored cars for breakthrough and reconnaissance. Infantry units were equipped with Mosin‑Nagant M91/30 rifles, DP‑27 light machine guns, PPD‑34/38 submachine guns and 45 mm 19‑K anti‑tank guns. Artillery punch came from 76 mm F‑22 divisional guns, 122 mm M‑10 howitzers and 152 mm M‑20 heavy howitzers, while 50 mm 1938‑model mortars provided close‑in fire. The Soviet Air Force contributed Polikarpov I‑153 and I‑16 fighters and Tupolev SB bombers for air superiority and strategic bombing. The Finnish army relied mainly on Vickers 6‑ton tanks and captured Renault FT, used P35 rifles, KP/31 "Suomi" submachine guns and Lahti‑Saloranta M/26 light machine guns. Finnish artillery comprised 37 mm Bofors anti‑tank guns, 20 mm ITK‑35 AA guns and 105 mm H 10 howitzers, while the air arm operated Fokker D.XXI and Morane‑Saulnier 406 fighters and Bristol Blenheim bombers.
dossier.tactics: 蘇聯採用大兵團正面突破戰術，先以密集炮火準備摧毀敵方工事，隨即投入坦克與步兵混合編隊實施縱深攻擊，試圖在卡累利阿地峽的曼納海姆防線上撕開缺口。為補償地形不利，蘇聯在冬季大量使用滑雪部隊與空降兵進行側翼包抄，並在春季解凍前加速突破。芬蘭則根據峽谷、湖泊與森林的天然障礙，採用小單位機動作戰，以滑雪兵快速轉移，利用夜間襲擊與包圍戰術，將蘇軍的長列縱隊切割成孤立的“motti”（叢林）集團，再以集中火力殲滅。芬蘭炮兵則隱蔽於地形中，使用間瞄射擊與機動火力支援，抵消蘇聯的火力優勢。
dossier.tacticsEn: The Soviet strategy was based on massed, front‑wide offensives. A heavy artillery barrage was used to demolish Finnish fortifications, after which combined‑arms groups of tanks and infantry pushed forward to breach the Mannerheim Line on the Karelian Isthmus. To compensate for difficult terrain, the Soviets employed ski‑troops and airborne units for flanking maneuvers and accelerated their push before the spring thaw. Finland, by contrast, exploited the natural obstacles of lakes, forests and narrow valleys, using small‑unit mobile warfare. Ski‑infantry moved swiftly, conducted night raids and surrounded Soviet columns in isolated "motti" (forest) pockets, which were then destroyed by concentrated fire. Finnish artillery hid in the terrain, delivering indirect fire and mobile support to offset Soviet fire superiority.
dossier.data: 1939年11月30日凌晨，蘇聯第9軍團在卡累利阿地峽的庫奧拉赫蒂省境內發起第一波攻勢，蘇軍第14軍團沿拉多加湖北岸推進。12月初，蘇軍在凱爾亞（Kelja）與蘇姆馬（Summa）展開激烈防禦戰，芬蘭守軍在12月9日至12月15日間成功組織反擊，迫使蘇軍在部分地段暫時停滯。1940年1月，蘇聯重新調動第7軍團，於2月間在霍恩卡尼米（Honkaniemi）與拉烏馬（Rauma）兩線發起總攻，炮火覆蓋範圍達數十平方公里，坦克突破曼納海姆防線多處缺口。3月5日，蘇軍在卡累利阿地峽的佩塔雅莫（Petäjä）取得決定性突破，隨即於3月12日在莫斯科簽署和平條約，結束為期約三個月的激烈武裝衝突。
dossier.dataEn: On the early morning of 30 November 1939, the Soviet 9th Army launched the first wave of attacks across the Kuhalahti sector of the Karelian Isthmus, while the 14th Army advanced along the north coast of Lake Ladoga. In early December, heavy fighting erupted at Kelja and Summa; Finnish defenders mounted a counter‑offensive from 9 to 15 December, temporarily halting Soviet progress in several sectors. In January 1940, the Soviets repositioned the 7th Army, and in February launched a major offensive on the Honkaniemi and Rauma fronts; artillery concentrations covered dozens of square kilometres and tanks pierced multiple gaps in the Mannerheim Line. On 5 March the Soviet forces achieved a decisive breakthrough near Petäjä on the Isthmus, leading directly to the signing of the Moscow Peace Treaty on 12 March, which ended roughly three months of intense combat.
dossier.cause: 冬季戰爭的根本起因是蘇聯對列寧格勒安全的戰略憂慮。1939年8月蘇德簽訂互不侵犯條約後，斯大林認為芬蘭與蘇聯的邊界過於靠近列寧格勒，威脅到該城市的防禦纵深。蘇聯遂於同年10月向芬蘭提出領土交換條件，要求租借漢科半島與部分卡累利阿邊界土地，以建立北部緩衝區。芬蘭政府基於主權與民族尊嚴，拒絕接受蘇聯的苛刻要求，並在談判中保持強硬立場。雙方在外交失敗後，蘇聯決定以軍事手段強行改變現狀，於是策動對芬蘭的全線侵略。
dossier.causeEn: The root cause of the Winter War was the Soviet Union’s strategic concern for the security of Leningrad. After signing the Molotov‑Ribbentrop Pact with Nazi Germany in August 1939, Joseph Stalin viewed the Finnish‑Soviet border as too close to Leningrad, endangering the city’s defensive depth. In October 1939 Moscow demanded territorial exchanges, seeking to lease the Hanko Peninsula and parts of the Karelian border to create a northern buffer zone. The Finnish government, citing national sovereignty and dignity, rejected the harsh terms and maintained a firm stance during negotiations. With diplomacy failing, the Soviet leadership decided to change the status quo by force, ordering a full‑scale invasion of Finland.
dossier.impact: 戰後，芬蘭被迫將卡累利阿地峽、維堡及拉多加湖畔的大片領土割讓給蘇聯，領土面積約佔全國的10%。雖然芬蘭保留了主權與政治體制，但大量軍事設施、工廠與交通網絡被迫遷移，導致國家資源重新配置。蘇聯在國際上因違反國際法與大規模軍事行動而受到譴責，國際聯盟於1939年12月驅逐蘇聯出盟，但蘇聯卻借此加強了對波羅的海三國的控制。蘇軍在冬季戰爭中暴露出兵種協同、指揮控制及後勤供應的不足，促使其後在1940年春季進行軍隊改革與裝備更新。此役同時提升芬蘭軍隊的國際聲譽，並為後來的繼續抵抗奠定基礎。
dossier.impactEn: In the aftermath, Finland was forced to cede the Karelian Isthmus, Viipuri and large swaths of the Ladoga‑Lake region to the Soviet Union—approximately ten percent of its territory. Although Finland retained its sovereignty and political system, the loss of numerous military installations, factories and transport networks forced a major reallocation of national resources. The Soviet Union faced international condemnation for violating international law and for the scale of its military campaign; the League of Nations expelled the USSR in December 1939, while the Soviet leadership consolidated control over the Baltic states. The war exposed serious deficiencies in Soviet combined‑arms coordination, command and control, and logistics, prompting a series of reforms and equipment upgrades in the spring of 1940. For Finland, the conflict boosted its army’s international reputation and laid the groundwork for subsequent resistance.
dossier.result: 1940年3月12日，莫斯科和平條約正式簽署，標誌著冬季戰爭的終結。根據條約，芬蘭將卡累利阿地峽、維堡及漢科半島等領土割讓給蘇聯，蘇聯則取得通往列寧格勒的安全通道。雖然芬蘭在物質上蒙受重大損失，但成功保住了國家獨立與政治制度，並迫使蘇聯在後續的蘇芬關係中接受更為謹慎的態度。此役使雙方均得到重要的教訓：蘇聯認識到僅靠數量優勢不足以快速壓制地形複雜的對手，芬蘭則體認到即使在劣勢裝備下，仍可透過灵活的游擊與防守戰術取得可觀的軍事成效。
dossier.resultEn: The Moscow Peace Treaty, signed on 12 March 1940, officially concluded the Winter War. Under its terms Finland surrendered the Karelian Isthmus, Viipuri and the Hanko Peninsula to the Soviet Union, granting the USSR a secure corridor to Leningrad. Despite heavy material losses, Finland preserved its independence and political structure, and forced the Soviet Union to adopt a more cautious posture in future Finnish‑Soviet relations. Both sides drew critical lessons: the Soviet Union realized that sheer numerical superiority could not quickly overwhelm a determined opponent in difficult terrain, while Finland demonstrated that, even with inferior equipment, flexible guerrilla and defensive tactics could achieve significant military results.

battle.name: 中印邊境戰爭
battle.brief: 1962年10月，中印兩軍在喜馬拉雅山脈東段與西段的高海拔山口交火。中國人民解放軍步兵以已列裝的56式突擊步槍配屬班排，在山地推進中提供近距火力。

kit.name: 56式突擊步槍
kit.history: 1956年列裝的中國制式突擊步槍，1962年中印邊境戰爭期間配屬入藏與新疆方向的步兵部隊，用於山地近戰。

dossier.cause: 中印边境战争的根源可追溯至20世纪初的英帝國劃界與中國、印度的領土主張交錯。1950年代，中華人民共和國在西藏建立實際控制後，對於新疆與西藏交界的中段與西段——即今日的阿克賽欽高原——展開行政與軍事部署；而印度則依據英屬印度時期的地圖，堅持麥克馬洪線為東段邊界，並向北推進「前進政策」，在雙方聲稱的重疊區域設立哨所。1959年，拉薩事件後，北京對新德里的不信任加深，雙方在邊境線上的巡邏與對峙頻繁升級，最終在1962年10月20日爆發武裝衝突。這場戰爭的導火索，既是領土主權的長期爭議，也是冷戰時期兩大意識形態陣營在亞洲腹地的地緣博弈。
dossier.causeEn: The origins of the Sino‑Indian border war can be traced to the early twentieth‑century imperial demarcations of the British Empire and the overlapping territorial claims of China and India. In the 1950s, after the People's Republic of China established de facto control over Tibet, it began administrative and military deployment in the western and central sectors of the disputed area—today known as the Aksai Chin plateau—while India, citing British‑era maps, insisted on the McMahon Line as the eastern border and pursued a “forward policy,” establishing posts in the overlapping zones. The 1959 Lhasa uprising deepened Beijing's distrust of New Delhi, and patrols and confrontations along the frontier escalated, finally erupting into armed conflict on 20 October 1962. The war's trigger was both a prolonged dispute over sovereignty and a geopolitical contest between the two ideological camps of the Cold War in the heart of Asia.
dossier.countries: 交戰雙方分別是中華人民共和國與印度共和國。中國方面由中央軍委直接指揮，具體作戰由西藏軍區（亦稱為新疆軍區西部）下屬的第54、第55、第56等步兵師擔任主攻，另有炮兵、裝甲與工程單位支援。印度方面，則由陸軍參謀部統籌，東段以第4師、第5師與第7師為骨幹，西段則動員第19步兵師及第28步兵旅等兵力。兩國在國際舞台上均有冷戰盟友的背景：蘇聯在初期向北京提供了少量防空與技術裝備，而美國則透過巴格達公約組織向印度提供情報與後勤援助，但不直接介入地面作戰。雙方的政治體制、經濟實力與軍事現代化程度差異，決定了戰場上的資源投入與後勤保障的根本不平衡。
dossier.countriesEn: The two principal belligerents were the People's Republic of China and the Republic of India. On the Chinese side, operations were directed by the Central Military Commission, with the Tibet Military Region (also referred to as the western part of the Xinjiang Military Region) commanding infantry divisions such as the 54th, 55th and 56th as the main strike forces, supplemented by artillery, armor and engineering units. The Indian side was coordinated by the Army Headquarters, deploying the 4th, 5th and 7th Infantry Divisions in the east and the 19th Infantry Division and the 28th Infantry Brigade in the west. Both nations had Cold‑War allies: the Soviet Union provided limited air‑defence and technical equipment to Beijing, while the United States supplied intelligence and logistics to India through the Baghdad Pact organization, though it did not commit ground forces. The differences in political system, economic strength and level of military modernization between the two sides determined the fundamental imbalance in resources and logistical support on the battlefield.
dossier.people: 中國軍隊的關鍵指揮官包括當時的西藏軍區司令員張國華、參謀長李作戰（亦稱李左雍）以及副司令員楊得志，他們共同策劃「快速突擊、分割包圍」的作戰方針。前線部隊以第54師第130團、第55師第157團及第56師第169團為骨幹，官兵多數為來自四川、甘肅的志願兵，具備高原適應與山地作戰的基礎訓練。印度方面，東段主力由第4師師長馬哈文·辛格率領，該師下轄的第11、第12、第62步兵團在達旺方向的激烈交火中傷亡慘重；西段則由第19師師長K·S·Thimayya（後因病離任）與代理師長B·M·考爾共同指揮，基層士兵多為來自旁遮普與阿薩姆的志願兵。雙方在高原作戰中均面臨嚴峻的後勤瓶頸與傷亡救治挑戰，後方醫療站與救護連的設置直接影響了持續作戰能力。
dossier.peopleEn: Key Chinese commanders included Tibet Military Region commander Zhang Guohua, chief of staff Li Zuoyong (also known as Li Zuo Yong) and deputy commander Yang Dezhi, who together formulated the strategy of “rapid assault and encirclement.” Front‑line units were built around the 130th Regiment of the 54th Division, the 157th Regiment of the 55th Division and the 169th Regiment of the 56th Division, with most troops recruited from Sichuan and Gansu, possessing basic training in high‑altitude and mountain warfare. On the Indian side, the eastern sector's main force was commanded by Major General Mahaveen Singh of the 4th Infantry Division; its 11th, 12th and 62nd Infantry Regiments suffered heavy losses in the fierce fighting around Tawang. In the western sector, the 19th Infantry Division was led by Major General K. S. Thimayya (who later fell ill) and then by acting commander B. M. Kaul, while the rank‑and‑file consisted mainly of volunteers from Punjab and Assam. Both sides faced severe logistical bottlenecks and medical evacuation challenges in the high‑altitude environment, and the setup of rear‑area medical stations and ambulance companies directly affected sustained combat capability.
dossier.kits: 裝備方面，雙方皆使用當代已列裝的武器系統。解放軍步兵主要配備56式步槍（仿製蘇聯AK-47），口徑7.62×39mm；另配備53式7.62mm半自動步槍與54式手槍，以滿足近距離與指揮需求。支援火力包括54式122mm榴彈炮、59式130mm加農炮以及53式82mm迫擊炮，炮兵編制為營級，每營配6門炮。裝甲力量則以62式輕型坦克和少量59式主力坦克為主，後者口徑100mm，足以壓制印度的前線火力。印度軍隊則廣泛使用英式.303口徑的No.4李-恩菲爾德步槍，並於1960年代初期開始配備7.62mm口徑的L1A1自動步槍（仿製FN FAL）。支援火力包括25磅炮（88mm）、3.7英寸防空炮、5.5英寸中型火炮以及3英寸迫擊炮，形成較為傳統的火力層次。雙方均缺乏現代化的夜視裝備與電子對抗手段，導致夜間作戰主要依賴聽覺與地形優勢。
dossier.kitsEn: In terms of equipment, both sides fielded weapons that were already in service by 1962. The PLA infantry was principally equipped with the Type 56 rifle, a copy of the Soviet AK‑47 firing the 7.62×39 mm cartridge, supplemented by the Type 53 7.62 mm semi‑automatic rifle and the Type 54 pistol for close‑quarters and command use. Supporting firepower consisted of the Type 54 122 mm howitzer, the Type 59 130 mm gun, and the Type 53 82 mm mortar, organized in artillery battalions of six guns each. Armor assets included the Type 62 light tank and a limited number of Type 59 main battle tanks, the latter equipped with a 100 mm gun capable of suppressing Indian front‑line positions. The Indian Army widely used the British .303‑calibre Lee‑Enfield No. 4 rifle and, from the early 1960s, began issuing the 7.62 mm L1A1 automatic rifle (a copy of the FN FAL). Supporting weapons comprised the 25‑pounder (88 mm) gun, the 3.7‑inch anti‑aircraft gun, the 5.5‑inch medium gun and the 3‑inch mortar, forming a more traditional fire‑support hierarchy. Neither side possessed modern night‑vision or electronic‑warfare equipment, so night operations relied heavily on auditory cues and terrain advantage.
dossier.tactics: 戰術上，解放軍採用「快速分割、側翼包抄」的運動戰模式。兵力在高原山谷中以步兵連、排為單位實施夜襲，利用事先偵察的山道繞過印度主要防線，然後在關鍵高地集中火力壓制。炮兵則先以密集火力破壞印度前沿哨所的防御設施，隨即由步兵衝鋒奪取陣地。為確保後勤供應，解放軍在後方設立了多層物資轉運點，使用駱駝與高原卡車在海拔4500米以上的山路運輸彈藥、糧食與醫療物資。印軍則傾向靜態防禦，哨所多依託山脊構築，缺乏機動作戰的預備隊。指揮結構層級過多，導致情報傳遞與命令執行延遲，尤其在惡劣天氣下通訊線路屢屢中斷。最終，解放軍的快速機動與集中兵力優勢，使印軍在多條戰線上陷入被動。
dossier.tacticsEn: Strategically, the PLA employed a “rapid division, flanking encirclement” style of mobile warfare. Infantry companies and platoons carried out night raids through mountain valleys, using pre‑reconnoitered trails to bypass Indian main defensive positions, then concentrated fire on key high ground before assaulting. Artillery preceded the infantry with a barrage designed to destroy forward post fortifications, after which the infantry surged forward to capture the positions. To ensure supply, the PLA established multiple-layer logistic transfer points along routes over 4,500 m altitude, using camels and high‑altitude trucks to haul ammunition, food and medical supplies. Indian forces, by contrast, favored static defense, with posts built along ridges and lacking mobile reserves. Their command hierarchy was overly layered, causing delays in intelligence flow and order execution, especially when communication lines were repeatedly disrupted by severe weather. Ultimately, the PLA's speed and concentration of forces forced the Indian troops into a passive posture on multiple fronts.
dossier.data: 作戰時間表顯示，1962年10月20日解放軍在東段（達旺）與西段（阿克賽欽）同步發起進攻，24日已占領達旺鎮，11月初則在西部奪取了包括加勒萬在內的多個高地。整場衝突持續至11月20日為止，解放軍共投入約30,000至40,000名官兵，印軍則約有25,000至30,000名士兵參與。傷亡統計方面，解放軍約有800人傷亡（約400人陣亡），印軍傷亡約6,500人（約2,000人陣亡），另有近4,000名印度士兵被俘。雙方在山區作戰期間，由於極端低溫與缺氧環境，凍傷與高山疾病成為非戰鬥傷亡的主要因素。物資消耗方面，解放軍在戰役期間發射了約12,000發炮彈與20,000發迫擊炮彈，彈藥與燃料的後勤運輸線路屢屢被迫延長，顯示出高原戰爭對後勤的極大考驗。
dossier.dataEn: The operational timeline shows that on 20 October 1962 the PLA launched simultaneous attacks in the east (Tawang) and the west (Aksai Chin). By 24 October the town of Tawang had fallen, and in early November the western forces captured several heights including Galwan. The conflict lasted until 20 November, with the PLA committing roughly 30,000–40,000 troops and India deploying about 25,000–30,000 soldiers. Casualty figures indicate the PLA suffered about 800 casualties (roughly 400 killed), while Indian losses were about 6,500 (around 2,000 killed) with nearly 4,000 Indian soldiers taken prisoner. In the mountain environment, extreme cold and hypoxia turned frostbite and high‑altitude illness into major non‑combat causes of loss. Materiel consumption was heavy: the PLA fired approximately 12,000 artillery rounds and 20,000 mortar rounds during the campaign, and the extension of supply lines over high terrain imposed a severe test on logistics.
dossier.impact: 戰爭的影響深遠。對印度而言，1962年的失敗暴露了軍隊在高海拔作戰中的嚴重不足，迫使新德里在隨後數年內展開大規模的軍事現代化與改革，包括增設山地師、購買新型火炮與空中支援平台，並設立專門的高原作戰培訓機構。對中國而言，雖然在軍事上取得壓倒性勝利，但國際輿論壓力與蘇聯的冷淡態度促使北京在1962年底單方面宣布停火並撤回實際控制線，藉此避免與美蘇兩大阵营的正面對抗。此役同時加劇了亞洲冷戰格局，美國加強了對印度的軍援，而蘇聯則在軍事技術合作上保持對中國的有限支持，雙方的戰略競爭在亞洲腹地呈現出更複雜的態勢。
dossier.impactEn: The war's impact was profound. For India, the 1962 defeat exposed critical deficiencies in high‑altitude combat capability, prompting New Delhi to launch extensive modernization and reforms in the following years, including the creation of dedicated mountain divisions, the acquisition of new artillery and air‑support platforms, and the establishment of specialized high‑altitude training schools. For China, despite a overwhelming military victory, international pressure and the Soviet Union's cool stance induced Beijing to unilaterally declare a ceasefire and pull back to the original line of actual control, thereby avoiding a direct confrontation with the United States and the Soviet Union. The conflict also intensified Cold‑War dynamics in Asia: the United States increased military aid to India, while the Soviet Union limited its technical support to China, creating a more complex pattern of strategic rivalry on the continent.
dossier.result: 最終結果是中國在阿克賽欽高原的實際控制得到鞏固，東段的麥克馬洪線亦短暫被突破，但在北京宣布停火後，解放軍主動撤退至原來的「實際控制線」；印度方面則失去了數個前沿哨所，軍隊被迫重新部署於較低海拔的防線。此役奠定了日後中印邊境的「實際控制線」概念，並使得雙方在隨後的數十年間持續進行邊境會談與局部衝突。總體而言，1962年的中印邊境戰爭是一场以有限兵力快速決定勝負的高原衝突，雙方皆從中汲取教訓，形成日後亞洲地區軍備競賽與外交談判的重要參照。
dossier.resultEn: The final outcome was that China solidified its control over the Aksai Chin plateau, and in the east the McMahon Line was briefly breached, but after Beijing announced a ceasefire the PLA voluntarily withdrew to the previously held “line of actual control.” India lost several forward posts and was forced to redeploy its forces to lower‑altitude defensive positions. The war established the concept of the “line of actual control” along the Sino‑Indian border and set the stage for decades of border talks and occasional skirmishes. Overall, the 1962 Sino‑Indian border war was a high‑altitude conflict decided by a swift, limited‑scale offensive, and both sides drew lessons that shaped subsequent Asian military competition and diplomatic negotiations.

battle.name: 第四次中東戰爭
battle.brief: 1973年10月6日，埃及與敘利亞同時向西奈半島及戈蘭高地進攻，第四次中東戰爭展開。以色列裝甲部隊以已列裝的M60A1巴頓戰車配屬前線，在兩線以105毫米主砲支援步兵穩住陣地並實施反衝擊。

kit.name: M60A1巴頓戰車
kit.history: 1971年以色列自美國接收並列裝的M60A1，1973年配屬西奈與戈蘭方向的裝甲部隊，用於前線火力支援。

dossier.countries: 參與第四次中東戰爭的主要國家包括以色列、埃及、敘利亞、約旦、伊拉克以及部分阿拉伯國家的後勤支援。以色列動員了包括陸軍、空軍與海軍在內的約30萬兵力，其中陸軍主要配備M60巴頓坦克、馬加奇（Magach）系列的改進型坦克以及英國的百夫長（Centurion）坦克；空軍則以F-4「幽靈」II戰鬥機、幻影III（Mirage III）與A-4「天鷹」攻擊機為核心。埃及軍隊以第三軍與第二軍為骨幹，總兵力約25萬，主要裝備蘇製T-55、T-62坦克與BTR-60裝甲車，並由俄羅斯提供的SA-2、SA-3防空飛彈系統提供區域防空。敘利亞軍隊在戈蘭高地部署了第1、第3裝甲師，配備T-55與T-62坦克，以及自行研發的「石頭」反坦克飛彈與ZSU-23-4自行防空炮。約旦與伊拉克則提供有限的步兵與裝甲支援，協助埃及在蘇伊士運河東岸維持防線。美國與蘇聯在幕後提供武器裝備與情報支援，形成實質的代理人戰爭格局。
dossier.countriesEn: The principal countries involved in the Fourth Middle East War were Israel, Egypt, Syria, Jordan, Iraq, and several other Arab states providing logistical support. Israel mobilized roughly 300,000 troops comprising army, air force, and navy units. Its ground forces were equipped mainly with U.S. M60 Patton and locally upgraded Magach series tanks, as well as British Centurion tanks; the air force operated F‑4 Phantom II multirole fighters, Mirage III interceptors, and A‑4 Skyhawk attack aircraft. Egyptian forces, organized around the 2nd and 3rd Armies with about 250,000 personnel, were equipped primarily with Soviet‑made T‑55 and T‑62 tanks, BTR‑60 armored personnel carriers, and a layered air‑defence network that included SA‑2 and SA‑3 surface‑to‑air missiles. Syria deployed the 1st and 3rd Armored Divisions on the Golan Heights, fielding T‑55 and T‑62 tanks, domestically produced ‘Stone’ anti‑tank missiles, and ZSU‑23‑4 self‑propelled anti‑aircraft guns. Jordan and Iraq contributed limited infantry and armor to assist Egypt’s lines along the Suez Canal. The United States and the Soviet Union supplied weapons, intelligence, and diplomatic backing, turning the conflict into a de‑facto proxy war.
dossier.people: 戰場上的關鍵人物與指揮官形塑了整場戰役的走向。以色列方面，國防軍總參謀長大衛·埃拉扎爾（David Elazar）負責全軍的戰略部署；陸軍元帥伊扎克·拉賓（Yitzhak Rabin）指揮北方司令部，專注於戈蘭高地的防禦；空軍司令阿莫斯·約瑟夫（Amos Yosef）負責制空權的爭奪；而著名將領阿里埃勒·沙龍（Ariel Sharon）則率領第2師在蘇伊士運河東岸展開反擊。埃及方面，總統安瓦爾·薩達特（Anwar Sadat）主導政治決策，國防部長艾哈邁德·伊斯梅爾·阿里（Ahmed Ismail Ali）策劃「巴德爾行動」以突破運河防線；埃及武裝部隊副總參謀長穆罕默德·阿里·賈邁勒（Mohamed Ali Gamal）負責協調第3軍與第2軍的同步推進。敘利亞方面，總統哈菲茲·阿薩德（Hafez al‑Assad）指示軍隊在戈蘭高地發起主攻；武裝部隊總參謀長穆斯塔法·特拉斯（Mustafa Tlass）制定具體的步兵與裝甲兵配合方案。這些指揮官在關鍵時刻的決策直接影響了戰役的勝敗。
dossier.peopleEn: The key commanders and leaders shaped the course of the 1973 conflict. On the Israeli side, Chief of Staff David Elazar oversaw overall strategic deployment, while General Yitzhak Rabin commanded the Northern Command, focusing on the Golan front. Air Force Commander Amos Yosef directed the campaign for air superiority, and the renowned General Ariel Sharon led the 2nd Division in the counter‑offensive across the Suez Canal. In Egypt, President Anwar Sadat made the political decisions, while Defense Minister Ahmed Ismail Ali planned the “Badr” operation to breach the canal. Deputy Chief of Staff Mohamed Ali Gamal coordinated the synchronized advance of the 2nd and 3rd Armies. Syria’s President Hafez al‑Assad ordered the Golan offensive, and the Syrian Armed Forces Chief of Staff Mustafa Tlass devised the combined infantry‑armor tactics. Their decisions at critical moments directly determined the outcome of the battles.
dossier.kits: 雙方投入的武器裝備在技術層面上呈現出冷戰時期的典型對抗。以色列裝甲兵主要使用美國製造的M60巴頓（M60A1）與M48巴頓改裝版，這些坦克配備105毫米口徑的主炮與現代化的火控系統，能在沙漠環境中提供穩定的射擊精度。以色列空軍則配備F-4「幽靈」II多用途戰鬥機，具備掛載AGM-65小牛飛彈與Mk.82炸彈的能力，以及幻影III（Mirage III）提供的高速攔截與對地支援。A-4「天鷹」攻擊機則在低空轟炸中扮演重要角色。阿拉伯國家方面，埃及與敘利亞大量使用蘇製T-55與T-62坦克，前者配備100毫米口徑炮，後者配備115毫米滑膛炮，能在近距離與以色列坦克進行交火。步兵則裝備AK-47自動步槍與RPG-7火箭推進榴彈，提供近距離反裝甲能力。防空系統方面，埃及的SA-2與SA-3導彈形成高低搭配的攔截網，而敘利亞的SA-6「根弗」導彈則在低空威脅上提供重要防護。雙方皆使用ZSU-23-4自行防空炮，以四管23毫米機炮為核心，進行近距離對空壓制。
dossier.kitsEn: The weapons and equipment used by both sides reflected the Cold‑War balance of power. Israeli armor relied chiefly on the American M60 Patton (M60A1) and upgraded M48 Patton variants, armed with a 105‑mm gun and modern fire‑control systems that ensured accurate firing in desert conditions. The Israeli Air Force fielded the F‑4 Phantom II, capable of delivering AGM‑65 Maverick missiles and Mk 82 bombs, and the Mirage III for high‑speed intercept and ground‑attack missions, while the A‑4 Skyhawk performed low‑level strike duties. Arab forces, mainly Egypt and Syria, employed large numbers of Soviet T‑55 and T‑62 tanks; the T‑55 mounted a 100‑mm gun, the T‑62 a 115‑mm smoothbore cannon, enabling close‑range duels with Israeli armor. Infantry were equipped with AK‑47 automatic rifles and RPG‑7 rocket‑propelled grenades for short‑range anti‑tank action. Air‑defence comprised Egyptian SA‑2 and SA‑3 missiles providing high‑altitude cover, while Syrian SA‑6 Gainful missiles defended lower altitudes; both sides also operated ZSU‑23‑4 self‑propelled guns, a quartet of 23‑mm autocannons for close‑in anti‑aircraft fire.
dossier.tactics: 戰術層面，雙方皆採用了多層次的合成兵種協同作戰，並在關鍵節點上進行快速機動。以色列在「贖罪日」清晨的奇襲中，先以空軍的F-4戰鬥機實施大範圍電子干擾與精確轟炸，削弱埃及的雷達與防空系統；隨後在地面以M60坦克與步兵混合編隊，利用「突破」與「分割」戰術，快速穿越蘇伊士運河的薄弱點。埃及則在清晨的炮兵齊射後，動用配備「石頭」與「AT-3」反坦克飛彈的步兵，在運河岸邊構築密集的反裝甲火網，以防止以色列坦克的突破。敘利亞在戈蘭高地的進攻中，採用「先制」與「山地機動」的戰術，將步兵與輕型坦克結合，利用高地地形進行火力掩護，並以SA-6導彈系統干擾以色列空軍的低空轟炸。以色列在防守與反攻中，則使用「空地一體」的作戰模式，利用AH-1「眼鏡蛇」武裝直升機與M60坦克的火力協同，在關鍵的「中國農場」地區展開激烈爭奪，成功逆轉局面。
dossier.tacticsEn: Both sides employed multi‑layered combined‑arms tactics and rapid maneuver at key points. Israel’s surprise attack on Yom Kippur began with extensive electronic jamming and precision strikes by F‑4 Phantoms that degraded Egyptian radar and air‑defence networks. Ground forces then pushed M60 tanks and infantry in mixed formations, using “break‑through” and “envelopment” techniques to rapidly cross the weak points of the Suez Canal. Egypt, after a pre‑dawn artillery barrage, deployed infantry equipped with Stone and AT‑3 anti‑tank missiles to create dense anti‑armor fire screens along the canal banks, hoping to block Israeli tank breakthroughs. On the Golan Heights, Syria executed a “first‑strike” and “mountain‑mobile” doctrine, coupling infantry with light tanks and using the terrain for fire support, while SA‑6 missiles attempted to suppress Israeli low‑level air attacks. In the defensive and counter‑attack phases, Israel used an “air‑ground integration” concept, coordinating AH‑1 Cobra attack helicopters with M60 tanks to wrestle control of the strategic “Chinese Farm” area, ultimately turning the tide.
dossier.data: 以下為戰役的關鍵時間節點與重要事件：1973年10月6日清晨6時30分，埃及第2軍與第3軍在蘇伊士運河東岸的德維索伊爾與塔薩地區同步展開渡河行動，砲兵以150門122毫米D-30與130毫米M-46火砲實施密集轟炸，掩護步兵與BTR-60裝甲車渡河。同一時間，敘利亞第1裝甲師在戈蘭高地的阿爾-庫奈特拉與阿爾-拉沙阿發動攻勢，使用T-55坦克與步兵在凌晨5時開始向前推進。10月7日，以色列空軍在赫茲利亞上空與埃及MiG-21展開空戰，擊落至少12架敵機。10月8日，以色列第7裝甲旅在埃及防線的「中國農場」地區實施側翼包圍，成功突破埃及第3軍的防線。10月10日，敘利亞軍隊在以色列第188裝甲旅的頑強抵抗下被迫後撤，雙方在戈蘭高地形成膠著。10月15日，以色列第2師在阿里埃勒·沙龍率領下，在蘇伊士運河西岸的伊斯梅利亞附近進行「過河」行動，成功佔領運河西岸的要點。10月22日，聯合國安理會通過第338號停火決議，雙方於10月24日正式停火，並在同年11月開始撤軍談判。
dossier.dataEn: The following timeline outlines the critical dates and events of the campaign: at 06:30 on 6 October 1973, the Egyptian 2nd and 3rd Armies simultaneously crossed the Suez Canal near Deversoir and Tasa, with 150 122‑mm D‑30 and 130‑mm M‑46 artillery pieces delivering a concentrated barrage to cover the infantry and BTR‑60 vehicles. Concurrently, the Syrian 1st Armored Division launched its offensive on the Golan Heights at 05:00, using T‑55 tanks and infantry to push forward. On 7 October, Israeli F‑4s engaged Egyptian MiG‑21s in aerial combat over the Sinai, downing at least twelve enemy aircraft. On 8 October, the Israeli 7th Armored Brigade encircled the Egyptian 3rd Army’s flank at the “Chinese Farm”, breaching the Egyptian line. By 10 October, Syrian forces, halted by the fierce resistance of the Israeli 188th Armored Brigade, were forced to retreat, leaving the Golan front in a stalemate. On 15 October, Israeli 2nd Division under Ariel Sharon crossed the canal west of Ismailia, securing a foothold on the western bank. The United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 338 on 22 October, and a formal cease‑fire took effect on 24 October, leading to disengagement negotiations in November.
dossier.cause: 1973年10月6日第四次中東戰爭爆發的根本原因可追溯至1967年六日戰爭後的領土佔領。以色列在六日戰爭中迅速佔領了埃及的西奈半島、敘利亞的戈蘭高地及約旦的約旦河西岸，此後阿拉伯國家雖在外交上尋求復原，但在軍事與政治上皆未放棄收復失地的目標。埃及總統安瓦爾·薩達特在1970年代初期決定以軍事行動打破僵局，藉助一次象徵性的「跨境」行動迫使國際社會重新關注中東問題，並期望在談判桌上取得更有利的地位。敘利亞的哈菲茲·阿薩德政權則因為戈蘭高地的持續佔領而感受到國家安全的直接威脅，遂與埃及形成軍事同盟，策劃同步進攻。此類領土争端、民族情感與經濟利益交織的複雜背景，成為戰爭爆發的根本動因。
dossier.causeEn: The root cause of the outbreak of the Fourth Middle East War on 6 October 1973 traces back to the territorial occupations that followed the Six‑Day War of 1967. During that conflict Israel rapidly seized the Sinai Peninsula from Egypt, the Golan Heights from Syria, and the West Bank from Jordan. Although Arab states pursued diplomatic avenues for restoration in the years that followed, they never abandoned the goal of reclaiming these lands by military means. Egyptian President Anwar Sadat, in the early 1970s, decided to use a limited but symbolic military operation to force the international community to refocus on the Middle East and to gain a stronger bargaining position at the negotiating table. The Syrian regime of Hafez al‑Assad felt directly threatened by the continued occupation of the Golan Heights, which it viewed as a vital security concern, and therefore entered into a military alliance with Egypt, planning a coordinated offensive. This complex background of territorial disputes, nationalist sentiment, and economic interests formed the fundamental impetus for the war.
dossier.impact: 戰爭的影響深遠且多方面，軍事、政治與經濟皆受到顯著衝擊。軍事上，以色列在初期陷入被動，促使其重新檢討國防政策，並在隨後幾年加速引進包括F-15、F-16戰鬥機與M1艾布拉姆斯坦克在內的下一代武器系統，以提升整體作戰能力。政治上，埃及總統薩達特成功將「軍事行動」轉化為外交談判的籌碼，於1977年訪問以色列並簽署《戴維營協議》，開創了阿拉伯-以色列和平的先例。敘利亞雖未能在軍事上奪回戈蘭高地，但通過軍事行動提升了自身在阿拉伯世界的地位，並在1974年的「脫離接觸」協議中部分恢復對戈蘭的控制。經濟方面，戰爭引發的石油危機促使石油輸出國組織（OPEC）對支持以色列的西方國家實施禁運，導致全球油價飆升，並對西方經濟產生深遠影響。美國在危機後大幅增加對以色列的軍事援助，並在中東部署更多海軍力量，以保護其戰略利益。
dossier.impactEn: The war’s impact was profound across military, political, and economic dimensions. Militarily, Israel’s initial setbacks forced a comprehensive review of its defence doctrine, prompting the rapid acquisition of next‑generation systems such as the F‑15, F‑16 fighters and later the M1 Abrams tank, which greatly enhanced its combat capabilities. Politically, President Sadat leveraged the military action into a diplomatic triumph, visiting Israel in 1977 and signing the Camp David Accords, which set the precedent for Arab‑Israeli peace negotiations. Syria, although failing to regain the Golan Heights by force, elevated its regional standing and secured a partial disengagement agreement in 1974, regaining limited control over parts of the plateau. Economically, the conflict triggered the 1973 oil crisis; OPEC’s embargo against Western supporters of Israel caused a worldwide spike in oil prices, severely affecting Western economies and prompting a strategic reassessment of energy policies. The United States dramatically increased military aid to Israel and expanded its naval presence in the Mediterranean to safeguard its interests.
dossier.result: 最終的戰爭結果呈現出「雙方皆有得失」的局面。以色列在軍事上取得關鍵勝利，成功阻止了阿拉伯軍隊的全面推進，並在蘇伊士運河西岸與戈蘭高地部分地區維持了軍事存在，確保了國家安全的基本底線。然而，以色列在人員與裝備上付出慘重代價，估計約有2,500至3,000名士兵陣亡，坦克與飛機損失亦相當可觀。埃及方面，儘管在軍事上未能完全達成收復西奈的目標，但在政治上取得了決定性的突破，迫使國際社會重新關注其領土要求，並在1978年的《戴維營協議》後逐步收回西奈大部分地區。敘利亞雖然在戈蘭高地的戰鬥中受挫，但在1974年的脫離接觸協議中獲得了部分地區的控制權，並在後續的外交談判中維持了對該地區的聲索。總體而言，第四次中東戰爭結束了阿拉伯國家對以色列的「軍事挑戰」階段，開啟了以談判解決衝突的新時代，並對後續的中東和平進程產生了深遠影響。
dossier.resultEn: The ultimate outcome of the Fourth Middle East War was a mixed result for both sides. Israel achieved decisive tactical victories, halting the Arab offensive and maintaining a presence on the western bank of the Suez Canal and in parts of the Golan Heights, thereby securing its essential security perimeter. However, Israel suffered heavy casualties, with estimates ranging from about 2,500 to 3,000 soldiers killed and significant losses of tanks and aircraft. Egypt, while unable to fully recover the Sinai militarily, succeeded politically by turning the conflict into a bargaining chip that led to the 1978 Camp David Accords and the subsequent return of most of the peninsula. Syria, although rebuffed in its Golan offensive, obtained limited territorial control under the 1974 disengagement accord and continued to assert its claim to the heights. In sum, the war ended the phase of large‑scale Arab military challenges to Israel, opened a new era of negotiated settlements, and set the stage for subsequent peace processes in the Middle East.

battle.name: 阿富汗戰爭
battle.brief: 2001年10月美軍在阿富汗山區展開「持久自由」行動，使用M4卡賓槍、M249機槍等輕武器掃蕩塔利班據點。

kit.name: M4卡賓槍
kit.history: 1994年定型，2001年部署至阿富汗山區，取代M16。

dossier.countries: 2001 年 10 月 7 日，美國在英國的支援下正式啟動「持久自由行動」，成為聯軍的核心。美國調派了海軍第 5 艦隊的航空母艦戰鬥群、空軍第 8 航空隊的 B‑2 與 B‑1 轟炸機以及多架 F‑15、F‑16 戰鬥機，兵力在阿富汗境內快速集結約 2,500 人；英國皇家空軍派遣颱風與旋風戰機、皇家海軍提供海上支援，兵力約 1,500 人；加拿大特種部隊聯合計劃小組（JTF2）於 11 月初抵達，部署約 200 名特勤；澳洲皇家特種空勤團（SASR）亦在 10 月底派員加入，約 300 人；德國、法國、義大利與土耳其等北約盟國則提供後勤、醫療與空中加油等支援，兵力合計約 1,000 人。此多國聯合作戰結構在 2001 年底前已完成部署，為後續地面行動奠定了廣泛的國際支援基礎。
dossier.countriesEn: On October 7 2001, the United States, with the United Kingdom as its principal ally, officially launched Operation Enduring Freedom, establishing the core of the multinational coalition. The U.S. deployed the carrier battle group of the 5th Fleet, Air Force 8th Air Force B‑2 and B‑1 bombers, and multiple F‑15 and F‑16 fighters, quickly assembling roughly 2,500 troops inside Afghanistan. The United Kingdom contributed Royal Air Force Typhoon and Tornado aircraft and Royal Navy maritime support, numbering about 1,500 personnel. Canada’s Joint Task Force 2 (JTF2) arrived in early November with about 200 special‑operations troops. Australia’s Special Air Service Regiment (SASR) sent around 300 troops in late October. Germany, France, Italy, Turkey and other NATO allies provided logistics, medical and aerial‑refueling support, bringing the total contribution to roughly 1,000 additional soldiers. This multinational structure was essentially in place by the end of 2001, laying a broad international foundation for subsequent ground operations.
dossier.people: 在持久自由行動初期，美國特種作戰司令部（USSOCOM）調動了第 75 遊騎兵團的營級分隊、陸軍特種部隊第 1 大隊的多支作戰分遣隊（ODA），以及海軍海豹突擊隊（DEVGRU）的若干小組，總人數約 200 余名。中央情報局（CIA）亦派出了約 100 名情報官與軍事顧問，配備輕型越野車與便攜式通信設備，與北方聯盟指揮官建立直接聯繫。英国特種空勤團（SAS）與皇家海軍陸戰隊第 40 突擊隊（RM）亦在 10 月中旬抵達，兵力約 150 人。加拿大 JTF2 約 80 名特勤官兵在 11 月初完成部署，澳洲 SASR 約 60 名特戰隊員亦加入前線。上述特種作戰力量以小組為單位，實施偵察、指引空襲與地面支援任務，形成與正規陸軍與空軍的緊密協同。
dossier.peopleEn: In the early phase of Enduring Freedom, U.S. Special Operations Command deployed elements of the 75th Ranger Regiment, several Operational Detachment‑Alpha (ODA) teams from the 1st Special Forces Group, and a handful of Naval Special Warfare Development Group (DEVGRU) squads, totaling roughly 200 operators. The Central Intelligence Agency also inserted about 100 intelligence officers and military advisors, equipped with light‑off‑road vehicles and portable radios, linking directly with Northern Alliance commanders. The United Kingdom’s Special Air Service (SAS) and Royal Marine 40 Commando arrived in mid‑October with roughly 150 troops, while Canada’s JTF2 contributed around 80 special‑operations personnel in early November and Australia’s SASR added about 60 operators to the front line. These small‑unit forces operated in close coordination with conventional army and air assets, conducting reconnaissance, directing air strikes and providing ground support throughout the campaign.
dossier.kits: 聯軍裝備的輕武器以 5.56 mm 北約口徑的 M16A2 步槍與 M4 卡賓槍為主，兩者均使用 M855 / M856 子彈；班用機槍包括 M249 自動步槍與 M240B 7.62 mm 機槍，後者發射 M80 子彈。手槍則採用 M9（Beretta 92）與 M11（SIG P226）。重型武器方面，步兵分隊配備 M2 .50 口徑重機槍與 Mk 19 40 mm 自動榴彈發射器，以提供壓制火力。地面車輛以 M998 高機動多用途輪式車（Humvee）為骨幹，配備防護裝甲板與 M2 重機槍或 Mk 19 榴彈發射器；部分單位使用 M113 裝甲運兵車與 LAV‑25 輕型裝甲車提升機動作戰能力。空中方面，AH‑64A 「阿帕奇」直升機配備 30 mm 鏈炮與地獄火（AGM‑114）飛彈，提供近距離空中支援；UH‑60A/L 「黑鷹」與 CH‑47D 「支努幹」則負責快速兵力投射與物資補給。固定翼戰機包括 F‑15C/D 「鷹」式、F‑15E 「打擊鷹」以及 F‑16C/D 「戰鬥獅」，皆配備 AIM‑120C/D 先進中程空對空飛彈與 GBU‑31/32 JDAM 精確制導炸彈；B‑1B 與 B‑2A 轟炸機在高空投放大量 JDAM，執行縱深轟炸任務。情報監視方面，MQ‑1A 「捕食者」無人機搭載 AGM‑114 地獄火飛彈，提供實時情報與定點打擊能力。所有作戰單位均配備 AN/PRC‑148 與 AN/PRC‑152 隨身通信電台，確保指揮控制暢通。
dossier.kitsEn: The coalition’s primary small arms were the 5.56 mm NATO M16A2 rifle and the M4 carbine, both firing M855/M856 ammunition; squad automatic weapons included the M249 SAW and the M240B 7.62 mm machine gun, using M80 ball ammunition. Handguns were the M9 (Beretta 92) and the M11 (SIG P226). Heavy weapons consisted of the M2 .50‑caliber heavy machine gun and the Mk 19 40 mm automatic grenade launcher for suppressive fire. Ground vehicles were based on the M998 Humvee, often fitted with armor kits and equipped with an M2 or Mk 19, while some units employed M113 armored personnel carriers and LAV‑25 wheeled armored vehicles for increased mobility. Aviation assets comprised AH‑64A Apache helicopters armed with a 30 mm chain gun and AGM‑114 Hellfire missiles for close‑air support; UH‑60A/L Black Hawks and CH‑47D Chinooks handled rapid troop insertion and resupply. Fixed‑wing fighters included F‑15C/D Eagles, F‑15E Strike Eagles and F‑16C/D Fighting Falcons, all equipped with AIM‑120C/D AMRAAMs and GBU‑31/32 JDAMs; B‑1B and B‑2A bombers conducted high‑altitude precision strikes. Intelligence‑surveillance‑reconnaissance (ISR) was provided by MQ‑1A Predator drones, which could launch Hellfire missiles for precision kill. All units used AN/PRC‑148 and AN/PRC‑152 handheld radios to maintain seamless command and control.
dossier.tactics: 聯軍作戰概念強調「空地一體」與「資訊化作戰」。在空襲階段，地面情報官（JTAC）利用激光指示器或 GPS 坐標，引導 F‑15E 與 B‑1B 投放 GBU‑31 JDAM，實現高精度打擊；MQ‑1A 「捕食者」無人機提供持續監視，並在確認目標後發射地獄火飛彈進行精準清除。空襲結束後，特種作戰小組迅速在目標區域實施快速繩降（fast‑rope）或透過 CH‑47D 直接著陸，與北方聯盟武裝配合建立前進基地（FOB）。在城鎮掃蕩行動中，步兵分隊以 Humvee 為機動平台，配備 M2 重機槍與 Mk 19 榴彈發射器，實施交叉火力压制；同時，AH‑64A 在低空提供近接支援，利用地獄火飛彈摧毀加固陣地。所有火力協調通過 AN/PRC‑148 與衛星通信完成，確保指令傳遞的即時性與準確性。整體而言，聯軍透過整合空中、地面與情報資源，形成多層次、精確且快速的打擊鏈，最大限度減少己方傷亡並快速削弱敵方指揮控制能力。
dossier.tacticsEn: The coalition’s operational concept stressed integrated air‑ground operations and information‑centric warfare. During the air‑campaign phase, Joint Terminal Attack Controllers (JTACs) on the ground used laser designators or GPS coordinates to guide F‑15E and B‑1B aircraft delivering GBU‑31 JDAMs, achieving high‑precision strikes. MQ‑1A Predator drones provided continuous surveillance and, once a target was confirmed, launched AGM‑114 Hellfire missiles for precision elimination. After air strikes, special‑operations teams rapidly inserted by fast‑rope or landed directly via CH‑47D helicopters, coordinated with Northern Alliance forces to establish forward operating bases (FOBs). In urban clearance operations, infantry squads used Humvees as mobile platforms armed with M2 heavy machine guns or Mk 19 grenade launchers to deliver cross‑fire suppression, while AH‑64A helicopters orbited at low altitude to provide close‑air support, employing Hellfire missiles against hardened positions. All fire‑support coordination was executed through AN/PRC‑148 radios and satellite communications, ensuring instantaneous and accurate transmission of orders. Overall, the coalition integrated air, ground and intelligence resources into a multi‑layered, precise and rapid strike chain, minimizing friendly casualties while rapidly degrading the enemy’s command and control.
dossier.data: 以下是持久自由行動的關鍵時間點與兵力部署資料：2001 年 10 月 7 日凌晨，美國與英國首先從紅海與波斯灣的航空母艦（第 5 艦隊）發動空襲，使用 B‑2、B‑1 轟炸機與 F‑16、F‑15E 進行首次精確轟炸，目標鎖定塔利班的指揮中心與防空設施。10 月 20 日，美國陸軍第 75 遊騎兵團的偵察分隊搭乘 MH‑60 直升機在巴爾赫省山區降落，與 CIA 人員會合並引導首波空襲。11 月 3 日，北方聯盟武裝在美軍空火力支援下突破塔利班前線，於 11 月 9 日奪回馬扎里沙里夫，俘獲大量塔利班官員。11 月 12 日，塔利班武裝撤離首都喀布爾，聯合國安理會隨後通過第 1378 號決議，支持成立過渡政府。12 月 5 日，《波恩協議》簽署，確立卡爾扎伊為臨時主席。12 月 7 日，美軍與英軍特種部隊在阿富汗南部展開聯合作戰，於 12 月 17 日攻占坎大哈，塔利班最高領袖奧馬爾逃往偏遠山區。2002 年 3 月初，代号「巨蟒行動」的美軍、澳軍與英軍特種分隊在沙伊科特山谷（Shah‑i‑Kot）展開激烈掃蕩，進行長達兩週的叢林與山地戰鬥，消耗塔利班剩餘兵力。此段時間內，聯軍總兵力約 10,000 人，其中美軍約 6,000 人，英軍 2,000 人，其他盟國約 2,000 人。這些時間與兵力數據提供了行動的完整輪廓，顯示出快速、空地結合與多方協調的特徵。
dossier.dataEn: The following key dates and force‑deployment data outline the timeline of Enduring Freedom: on 7 October 2001 at dawn, the United States and the United Kingdom launched the first air strikes from carriers in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf, employing B‑2 and B‑1 bombers together with F‑16s and F‑15Es against Taliban command centers and air‑defence sites. On 20 October, a reconnaissance detachment of the U.S. 75th Ranger Regiment inserted by MH‑60 helicopters in the Hindu Kush mountains, linking up with CIA personnel to direct the initial wave of air raids. On 3 November, Northern Alliance forces, supported by U.S. air power, broke through Taliban front lines and, on 9 November, liberated Mazar‑i‑Sharif, capturing senior Taliban officials. By 12 November, Taliban forces evacuated Kabul, prompting the UN Security Council to adopt Resolution 1378 endorsing an interim administration. The Bonn Agreement was signed on 5 December, establishing Hamid Karzai as Chairman of the Interim Administration. On 7 December, U.S. and British special‑operations units began joint operations in southern Afghanistan, leading to the capture of Kandahar on 17 December, while Taliban leader Mullah Omar fled to remote mountainous areas. In early March 2002, Operation Anaconda involved U.S., Australian and British special‑operations teams in the Shah‑i‑Kot valley, conducting a two‑week intense mountain and jungle fight that further degraded remaining Taliban resistance. Throughout this period, total coalition strength peaked at roughly 10,000 troops, with about 6,000 Americans, 2,000 British and 2,000 personnel from other allies. These dates and force numbers illustrate the rapid, air‑ground integrated and multinational nature of the campaign.
dossier.cause: 阿富汗戰爭的根本起因可追溯至 2001 年 9 月 11 日發生在美國的恐怖攻擊。基地組織（al‑Qaeda）在該日挾持民航機撞擊世界貿易中心與五角大樓，造成近 3,000 人死亡。美國政府指控在阿富汗境內的基地組織訓練營由塔利班政權提供庇護，並要求塔利班交出其領袖奧薩馬·本·拉登。塔利班領袖穆罕默德·奧馬爾公開拒絕外國干預，並持續為基地組織提供安全港與物資支援。面對無法透過外交手段達成的撤離要求，美國依據《聯合國憲章》第 51 條的自衛權，決定以軍事手段消除威脅。2001 年 10 月 7 日，美國與盟友啟動「持久自由行動」，目標明確：摧毁基地組織在阿富汗的訓練設施、瓦解塔利班武裝，並在政治上迫使其下台，以防止未來的恐怖攻擊。此役的正當性在於保護本國公民免受武裝攻擊，並透過國際合作維護全球安全。
dossier.causeEn: The root cause of the Afghanistan war traces back to the terrorist attacks of 11 September 2001 in the United States, in which al‑Qaeda hijacked commercial airliners and crashed them into the World Trade Center and the Pentagon, killing nearly 3,000 people. The U.S. government held the Taliban regime responsible for providing sanctuary to al‑Qaeda training camps in Afghanistan and demanded the handover of its leader, Osama bin Laden. Taliban leader Mullah Omar publicly refused any foreign interference and continued to offer safe haven and logistical support to al‑Qaeda. With diplomatic avenues exhausted, the United States invoked its inherent right of self‑defence under Article 51 of the United Nations Charter and decided to use military force to eliminate the threat. On 7 October 2001, the United States and its allies initiated Operation Enduring Freedom with the explicit objectives of destroying al‑Qaeda’s training infrastructure in Afghanistan, dismantling the Taliban’s armed forces, and forcing the regime’s removal from power to prevent future terrorist attacks. The war’s legitimacy was grounded in protecting its citizens from armed attack and in collective international efforts to uphold global security.
dossier.impact: 戰爭的即時影響是塔利班政權在不到三個月的時間內被推翻。2001 年 12 月底，卡爾扎伊成立過渡政府，開始在國際社會的支持下重建國家行政體系。與此同時，許多塔利班戰士被迫撤入巴基斯坦邊境的偏遠山區，形成游擊根據地，並逐步重組為武裝叛亂組織，對新政府與聯軍維持長期游擊戰。阿富汗的安全形勢在 2002 年至 2006 年間相對穩定，但隨著叛亂活動加劇，衝突再度升級，成為持久的地區戰爭。戰爭還加劇了巴基斯坦內部的宗教與民族緊張，因為巴國成為塔利班領導人逃亡的主要通道，並在情報與後勤上提供隱蔽支援。國際社會在軍事干預的同時，亦投入巨額資金用於阿富汗的國家建設與人道救援，改變了該地區的經濟與社會結構。總體而言，持久自由行動在短期內實現了主要軍事目標，但也在長期導致地區安全形勢的深刻變化。
dossier.impactEn: The immediate impact of the war was the overthrow of the Taliban regime in less than three months. By late December 2001, an interim government headed by Hamid Karzai was established under international auspices, beginning the reconstruction of Afghanistan’s administrative structures. Concurrently, many Taliban fighters withdrew into the rugged border regions of Pakistan, where they regrouped as an insurgency and gradually resumed guerrilla warfare against the new government and coalition forces. From 2002 through 2006, security was relatively stable, but as the insurgency gained momentum, conflict escalated, turning Afghanistan into a protracted regional war. The war also deepened internal religious and ethnic tensions in Pakistan, as the country became a conduit for Taliban leaders fleeing Afghanistan and provided them with intelligence and logistical support. While the international community invested heavily in nation‑building and humanitarian aid, the military intervention reshaped Afghanistan’s economic and social landscape. Overall, Enduring Freedom achieved its short‑term military objective of toppling the Taliban, but it also set the stage for long‑term security challenges that would define the region for decades.
dossier.result: 最終結果顯示，聯軍在 2001 年底成功剷除塔利班政權，基地組織在阿富汗的訓練營大多被摧毁，核心領導人如本·拉登在 2011 年於巴基斯坦阿伯塔巴德被美軍特種部隊擊斃，象徵性地結束了對其的直接追捕。然而，塔利班武裝並未被彻底消滅，其在阿富汗南部的根據地在 2000 年代中後期重新集結，並在 2021 年 8 月重新奪回首都喀布爾，完成政權更迭。美國及其北約盟國在 2021 年完成撤軍，結束了長達 20 年的軍事介入。從戰略角度看，持久自由行動展示了精確空中打擊、特種部隊與當地武裝相結合的混合戰模式，並檢驗了信息共享與聯盟作战的可行性。但同時也暴露了長期佔領與國家建設的困難，以及在缺乏持續政治共識的情況下，軍事勝利的可持續性受到質疑。這場戰爭的教訓對未來的反恐與衝突管理仍有深遠的參考價值。
dossier.resultEn: The ultimate result showed that by the end of 2001 the coalition had succeeded in dismantling the Taliban government and largely destroying al‑Qaeda’s training camps in Afghanistan. The killing of Osama bin Laden in May 2011 in Abbottabad, Pakistan, by U.S. special‑operations forces symbolically concluded the pursuit of the organization’s leadership. However, the Taliban were not entirely eradicated; they regrouped in the southern Afghan provinces and, after years of insurgency, recaptured Kabul in August 2021, completing a political comeback. The United States and its NATO allies completed their withdrawal later that year, ending 20 years of military involvement. From a strategic perspective, Operation Enduring Freedom demonstrated the effectiveness of combining precision air strikes, special‑operations forces and local allies in a hybrid warfare model, while also testing multinational command, control and information‑sharing mechanisms. Nonetheless, the experience exposed the difficulties of prolonged occupation and nation‑building without sustained political consensus, raising questions about the sustainability of military victories. The lessons learned continue to inform future counter‑terrorism and conflict‑resolution strategies.

battle.name: 復活節起義
battle.brief: 在都柏林市中心與英軍激烈交火，英軍使用李-恩菲爾德步槍於街道、佔領建築內掃射。

kit.name: 李-恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 英軍於1907年採用此步槍，裝備步兵與支援單位，廣泛用於一次大戰。

dossier.countries: 1916年復活節起義的參戰方主要為大英帝國武裝力量與愛爾蘭民族武裝組織。英方兵力包括駐紮於都柏林及周邊的皇家都柏林步兵團第一營、皇家愛爾蘭步兵團第二營、皇家因尼斯基林火槍團第三營以及第5輕騎兵團等正規兵團，並臨時動員了後備兵員與增援的炮兵連，總兵力約一萬二千人。愛爾蘭方面則以愛爾蘭義勇軍為主體，輔以少數工人階級武裝的愛爾蘭公民軍，總兵力約一千二百人，由數個營編制構成，分別佔據了郵政總局、四大法院、南都柏林兵工廠與伯蘭磨坊等關鍵建築。
dossier.countriesEn: The Easter Rising of 1916 involved primarily the armed forces of the British Empire and Irish nationalist armed groups. On the British side, the forces included the 1st Battalion of the Royal Dublin Fusiliers, the 2nd Battalion of the Royal Irish Regiment, the 3rd Battalion of the Royal Inniskilling Fusiliers, and the 5th Lancers, among other regular units, together with reserve detachments and artillery batteries, amounting to roughly 12,000 men. The Irish side was composed mainly of the Irish Volunteers, supplemented by a small number of the Irish Citizen Army, comprising about 1,200 men organized into several battalions that seized key sites such as the General Post Office, the Four Courts, the South Dublin Union (Jacob's factory) and Boland's Mill.
dossier.people: 起義的核心指揮結構由愛爾蘭義勇軍高層組成。帕特里克·皮爾斯（Patrick Pearse）擔任愛爾蘭共和國總統兼總指揮，詹姆斯·康諾利（James Connolly）任副指揮兼都柏林區司令，托馬斯·麥克多納（Thomas MacDonagh）指挥第二營，塞恩·麥克迪爾米德（Seán Mac Diarmada）負責政治與情報，埃蒙·肯特（Éamonn Ceannt）率領第四營，約瑟夫·普倫基特（Joseph Plunkett）擔任參謀長。各營兵力約在200至300人之間，總計約1,200名義勇軍。英國方面，地面指揮官為陸軍少將威廉·萊特（William Leir），前線行動由第5輕騎兵團的埃德蒙·貝克（Edmund Baker）上校與第1營皇家都柏林步兵團的湯瑪斯·格雷（Thomas Gray）中校共同執行，另有砲兵連長喬治·海伊（George Hay）少校提供火力支援。增援的步兵包括第2營皇家愛爾蘭步兵團與第3營皇家因尼斯基林火槍團，總兵力約1.2萬人。
dossier.peopleEn: The core command structure of the rebellion was formed by the senior leadership of the Irish Volunteers. Patrick Pearse served as President of the Irish Republic and Supreme Commander, James Connolly acted as Deputy Commander and Dublin area commander, Thomas MacDonagh commanded the 2nd Battalion, Seán Mac Diarmada handled political and intelligence work, Éamonn Ceannt led the 4th Battalion, and Joseph Plunkett served as Chief of Staff. Each battalion fielded between 200 and 300 men, giving a total strength of roughly 1,200 Volunteers. On the British side, ground command was exercised by Major‑General William Leir, while front‑line operations were carried out by Lt‑Col. Edmund Baker of the 5th Lancers and Lt‑Col. Thomas Gray of the 1st Battalion, Royal Dublin Fusiliers, with artillery support from Major George Hay. Reinforcements comprised the 2nd Battalion, Royal Irish Regiment, and the 3rd Battalion, Royal Inniskilling Fusiliers, raising the total British presence to about 12,000 troops.
dossier.kits: 在武器裝備方面，愛爾蘭義勇軍主要使用英國製的斯穆茲-李菲爾德（Short Magazine Lee‑Enfield）步槍，口徑.303英寸，型號為No.1 Mk III，配備10發彈匣；另有少數加拿大製的羅斯步槍，口徑同樣為.303，配備5發彈匣。突擊時使用的自動武器包括德國造的毛瑟C96半自動手槍，口徑7.63×25mm，配備10發或20發彈匣；以及少數的美式柯爾特M1911手槍，口徑.45 ACP，近距離作戰中提供火力支援。機槍方面，雙方均裝備有維克斯.303機槍與馬克沁M1914機槍，口徑同為.303，射速約每分鐘450發。榴彈則為英國的米斯手榴彈（No.5），每枚內含約2.5盎司的TNT，可在街頭構築爆炸障礙。彈藥方面，步槍使用的彈種包括.303 British Ball、Mk VII穿甲彈與訓練彈；手槍彈則有9mm帕拉貝魯姆、.45 ACP與7.63mm毛瑟彈。後勤補給主要依賴鐵路與卡車向都柏林市區輸送彈藥箱，每箱容納1,200發步槍彈或600發手槍彈，並配備便攜式醫療包與備用槍管。
dossier.kitsEn: In terms of weaponry, the Irish Volunteers were principally equipped with the British‑made Short Magazine Lee‑Enfield rifle, caliber .303 inch, model No.1 Mk III, with a ten‑round magazine; a few Ross rifles of Canadian origin, also .303 caliber and fitted with a five‑round magazine, were also used. Automatic weapons included the German Mauser C96 semi‑automatic pistol, 7.63×25 mm, loaded with ten‑ or twenty‑round magazines, and a limited number of American Colt M1911 pistols, caliber .45 ACP, for close‑quarters fire. Both sides fielded Vickers .303 machine guns and Maxim M1914 guns, also .303 caliber, with a cyclic rate of about 450 rpm. Hand grenades were the British Mills No.5 grenade, containing about 2.5 oz of TNT, used to create improvised explosive obstacles. Ammunition consisted of .303 British Ball, Mk VII armor‑piercing and training cartridges for rifles; pistol ammunition included 9 mm Parabellum, .45 ACP and 7.63 mm Mauser rounds. Logistical resupply was accomplished mainly by rail and truck, delivering ammunition crates of 1,200 rifle rounds or 600 pistol rounds each, together with portable medical kits and spare barrels.
dossier.tactics: 起義軍的戰術以快速集結與據守要點為核心。4月24日上午，義勇軍在都柏林市中心的多條街道同步出發，利用事先偵查的路線迅速佔領郵政總局、四大法院、南都柏林兵工廠與伯蘭磨坊等十餘座建築，並在入口設置臨時路障，使用沙袋、木板與倒塌的電車構築防線。狙擊手佔據屋頂與窗戶，以斯穆茲-李菲爾德步槍的精確射擊压制英軍前進；機槍手則在建築內部布置維克斯機槍，形成交叉火力覆蓋主要交叉口。義勇軍亦利用地下通道與舊排水渠進行兵員機動，減少在開闊街道上的暴露。英軍的應對則以集中火力與逐步清除為主。英國步兵在砲兵與迫擊炮的支援下，先以18磅野戰炮對目標建築進行定點轟炸，隨後以第5輕騎兵團的步兵排發起突擊，配合維克斯機槍的掩護火力，迫使義勇軍逐步退至內部走廊。英軍的裝甲車（裝甲轎車）則沿著主要道路巡邏，利用機槍掃射街道兩側，並為步兵提供近距離火力支援。整體戰術呈現出義勇軍以據點防御與游擊機動相結合，而英軍則以壓倒性的火力與機動兵力逐步收緊包圍圈。
dossier.tacticsEn: The rebels’ tactics centered on rapid concentration and the defense of key points. On the morning of 24 April, the Volunteers moved simultaneously along pre‑reconnoitred routes to occupy the General Post Office, the Four Courts, the South Dublin Union and Boland’s Mill, establishing improvised barricades at entrances using sandbags, timber and overturned tramcars. Snipers took up positions on rooftops and windows, using the Lee‑Enfield’s accuracy to suppress British advance, while machine‑gunners placed Vickers guns inside buildings to create cross‑fire covering major intersections. The rebels also used underground passages and old drainage channels to move troops, reducing exposure on open streets. The British response emphasized concentrated fire and methodical clearance. Supported by artillery and mortars, British infantry first subjected the rebel‑held buildings to point‑target bombardment with 18‑pounder field guns, then advanced in platoon‑size assaults of the 5th Lancers, covered by Vickers machine‑gun fire, gradually pushing the Volunteers back into interior corridors. Armored cars patrolled main thoroughfares, using their machine guns to sweep side streets and provide close‑range support for the infantry. Overall, the rebellion combined strong‑point defense with guerrilla‑style mobility, while the British relied on overwhelming firepower and mobile forces to tighten the encirclement.
dossier.data: 根據官方與歷史文獻的記載，復活節起義的軍事行動時間線如下：1916年4月24日（ Easter Monday）上午約12時30分，愛爾蘭義勇軍在各目標地點同步發動武裝佔領；同日，英國陸軍在收到報告後於下午2時左右開始集結，並在4月25日凌晨調派第5輕騎兵團與第1營皇家都柏林步兵團展開第一波進攻。4月26日至27日，英軍增援的第2營皇家愛爾蘭步兵團與第3營皇家因尼斯基林火槍團抵達前線，總兵力增至約1.2萬人，火炮包括6門18磅野戰炮與2門4.5英寸榴彈炮。作戰期間，義勇軍共發射步槍彈約30萬發，手槍彈約12萬發，機槍彈約8萬發；英軍則消耗步槍彈約45萬發，機槍彈約15萬發，並發射炮彈約2,400枚。傷亡方面，義勇軍約有200餘人受傷、約70人在戰鬥中陣亡，另有16名領導人在事後被判處死刑；英軍方面約有130至150名士兵死亡，260至300人受傷，後勤與醫療站救治約400名傷者。上述數字為現存檔案中的統計，因戰場環境與通訊限制，實際傷亡或有小幅偏差。
dossier.dataEn: According to official and historical sources, the chronology of the Easter Rising was as follows: on 24 April 1916 (Easter Monday) at about 12:30 p.m., the Irish Volunteers launched simultaneous armed seizures at their designated locations; later that day, after receiving reports, the British Army began concentrating forces and launched its first attack at about 2 p.m. on 25 April. By 26–27 April, reinforcements in the form of the 2nd Battalion, Royal Irish Regiment, and the 3rd Battalion, Royal Inniskilling Fusiliers arrived, raising British strength to roughly 12,000 men, supported by six 18‑pounder field guns and two 4.5‑inch howitzers. During the fighting, the Volunteers expended roughly 300,000 rifle cartridges, 120,000 pistol rounds and 80,000 machine‑gun rounds; the British forces used about 450,000 rifle cartridges, 150,000 machine‑gun rounds and fired approximately 2,400 shells. Casualties were: the Volunteers suffered about 200 wounded and roughly 70 killed in combat, with an additional sixteen leaders sentenced to death afterwards; British losses were between 130 and 150 dead and 260–300 wounded, while field hospitals treated around 400 wounded. These figures, drawn from surviving records, may be slightly inaccurate due to battlefield conditions and communication disruptions.
dossier.cause: 復活節起義的根本原因可追溯至19世紀末以來愛爾蘭民族主義的積累與一次大戰期間的政治危機。1914年英國通過第三次愛爾蘭自治法案（Home Rule Act），但因第一次世界大戰爆發而被擱置，導致愛爾蘭內部對於是否參戰產生了尖銳分歧。民族主義者認為英國的戰時政策只會將愛爾蘭推向更大的犧牲，尤其在英國於1916年實行徵兵制的傳聞刺激下，激進組織決定以武裝起義來展示愛爾蘭的獨立意志，並以此向同盟國尋求支持。組織者將起義時間選在復活節假期，利用英國軍隊休假與注意力分散的窗口期，期望在政治真空與國際關注之際，一舉奪取首都的關鍵設施，宣布成立愛爾蘭共和國。此類民族自決的願望與對大英帝國軍事擴張的不滿，交織成起義的深層動因。
dossier.causeEn: The root cause of the Easter Rising can be traced to the accumulation of Irish nationalist sentiment since the late nineteenth century combined with the political crisis generated by the First World War. The Third Home Rule Act passed by Britain in 1914 was suspended when war broke out, creating deep divisions within Ireland over participation in the war. Nationalists viewed Britain’s wartime policies as sacrificing Ireland, especially as rumors of impending conscription spread in 1916. Radical factions decided that an armed uprising would demonstrate Ireland’s will for independence and might secure support from Germany. The planners chose the Easter holiday to strike, taking advantage of reduced British troop presence and the distraction of the holiday, hoping to seize key facilities in Dublin, declare an Irish Republic, and exploit the resulting political vacuum and international attention. This desire for self‑determination, together with resentment toward British military expansion, formed the underlying motivations for the revolt.
dossier.impact: 起義的軍事行動在短短數日內對都柏林市造成了毀滅性破壞，並在政治層面引發深遠影響。英軍的砲擊與巷戰導致市中心的郵政總局、四大法院及多條街道被大火吞噬，市政設施與交通網絡幾乎陷入停頓，迫使英國政府必須緊急調配資源進行重建與救濟。起義失敗後，英國當局快速處決了包括帕特里克·皮爾斯、詹姆斯·康諾利在內的十六名領導人，並對其餘參與者進行長期監禁。此舉在愛爾蘭社會中激起強烈反感，原本對自治較為溫和的輿論轉向支持更激進的獨立運動。歷史學者普遍認為，復活節起義成為日後愛爾蘭共和軍（IRA）游擊戰略的思想源頭，並在1919年至1921年的英愛戰爭中提供了組織與意識形態的參照。更廣泛地看，起義提升了民族自決運動在國際舞台的能見度，促使英國在1920年代的愛爾蘭政策不得不重新考量區域自治與聯邦制的可能性。
dossier.impactEn: The military actions of the Rising inflicted devastating damage on central Dublin and produced far‑reaching political consequences. British artillery and street fighting set the General Post Office, the Four Courts and numerous streets ablaze, halting municipal services and transport. The British government was forced to allocate emergency resources for reconstruction and relief. In the aftermath, the British authorities swiftly executed sixteen leaders, including Patrick Pearse and James Connolly, and imprisoned the remaining participants for long terms. This harsh response aroused intense resentment within Irish society, shifting even moderate opinion toward support for more radical independence movements. Historians generally agree that the Easter Rising provided the ideological and organizational seedbed for the guerrilla tactics later employed by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) during the War of Independence (1919‑1921). More broadly, the Rising heightened the visibility of Irish self‑determination on the world stage, compelling Britain to reconsider its Irish policy and ultimately leading to the Government of Ireland Act 1920, which created the partitioned North and South, and to the establishment of the Irish Free State in 1922.
dossier.result: 1916年4月29日，隨著英軍火力與兵力持續加壓，剩餘的義勇軍在郵政總局的最後防線被迫撤離，指揮官帕特里克·皮爾斯在當天向英方投降，並簽署了停火協定。隨後，詹姆斯·康諾利因腿部重傷被俘，亦在同日向英軍投降。起義的核心領導層幾乎全部被捕，其中十六人在隨後的軍事法庭中被判處死刑，並於同年5月3日至12日間陸續處決；其餘俘虜則被押送至英國監獄，進行長期監禁。雖然起義本身在軍事上失敗，但它在政治上打破了英國對愛爾蘭的治理預期，迫使倫敦於1920年通過《政府愛爾蘭法案》（Government of Ireland Act），為北愛爾蘭與南愛爾蘭的分離奠定法理基礎，並最終促成了1922年愛爾蘭自由邦的成立。整體而言，復活節起義雖然以失敗告終，但其政治與象徵意義卻為未來的獨立運動提供了關鍵的催化劑。
dossier.resultEn: On 29 April 1916, as British firepower and numbers continued to intensify, the remaining rebels were forced to abandon the final defenses of the General Post Office. Patrick Pearse surrendered to the British that day, signing a cease‑fire agreement, while James Connolly, gravely wounded, was captured and also surrendered. Almost the entire senior leadership was arrested; sixteen were sentenced to death by a military tribunal and executed between 3 May and 12 May 1916, and the rest were sent to British prisons for long‑term detention. Although militarily a failure, the rebellion shattered British expectations of governing Ireland and forced London to pass the Government of Ireland Act 1920, laying the legal foundation for a partitioned Ireland and eventually leading to the creation of the Irish Free State in 1922. In summary, the Easter Rising, despite its defeat, supplied the crucial catalyst for future independence movements.

battle.name: 土耳其獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 1919年5月，協約國准許希臘軍於伊茲密爾登陸並向西內陸推進，引發安納托利亞各地的土耳其民族主義抵抗。穆斯塔法·凱末爾於薩姆松登陸後號召成立大國民議會軍，先後於第一次與第二次伊諾努戰役、薩卡里亞河戰役中以步槍與機槍火力遏制希軍推進，最終於1922年大攻勢將希軍逐出安納托利亞，並於1923年建立土耳其共和國。

kit.name: Gew 88步槍
kit.history: 德國於1888年定型的委員會步槍，後續由德軍以Gew 98替換後大量軍援鄂圖曼帝國。鄂圖曼軍於一戰結束後將其移交土耳其國民軍，土耳其共和國成立後繼續改良使用，服役期延伸至1940年代前後，於土耳其獨立戰爭期間為民族主義部隊可見的制式栓動步槍之一。

dossier.countries: 1919 年至 1923 年的土耳其獨立戰爭，鄂圖曼帝國仍是形式上的宗主國，然而其軍隊已由新成立的大國民議會（ Türkiye Büyük Millet Meclisi）指揮。與此同時，希臘遠征軍在伊茲米爾登陸，試圖佔據西海岸；亞美尼亞志願軍在東部山區展開軍事行動；法國與英國則在南部海岸和黑海港口部署兵力，執行物資與情報支援。意大利的少量艦隊亦在安塔利亞海域巡邏，試圖保護其在意屬黎凡特的利益。上述外國軍隊的介入，使得戰場呈現多國兵力交錯的局面，並迫使土耳其民族主義者必須在多條戰線上同時抵禦外敵。
dossier.countriesEn: The Turkish War of Independence, fought from 1919 to 1923, involved the Ottoman Empire—still the nominal sovereign—alongside the newly formed Turkish Grand National Assembly (TBMM). The Greek Expeditionary Force landed at İzmir, aiming to occupy the western coast; Armenian volunteers operated in the eastern highlands; France and the United Kingdom deployed troops along the southern coast and Black Sea ports, providing material and intelligence support; a small Italian squadron patrolled the Antalya waters to protect its Levantine interests. This multinational intervention created a complex battlefield where Turkish nationalists were forced to resist foreign forces on multiple fronts simultaneously.
dossier.people: 這場運動的核心人物為穆斯塔法·凱末爾·阿塔圖爾克（Mustafa Kemal Atatürk），他於 1919 年 5 月 19 日在薩姆松登陸後，立即組織「安卡拉代表大會」並成立大國民議會。主要的軍事指揮官包括卡茲姆·卡拉貝克爾（Kâzım Karabekir）率領東部兵團在卡爾斯與阿爾特溫一帶抵抗亞美尼亞軍；阿里·富阿特·切貝索伊（Ali Fuat Cebesoy）負責中部與西部的鐵路防禦與游擊行動；以及拉烏夫·奈迪姆（Rauf Orbay）在海軍與后勤方面協調資源。另外，恩維爾·帕夏（Enver Pasha）等舊鄂圖曼軍官亦在外交與情報領域提供支援，形成以阿塔圖爾克為首的統合指挥體系。
dossier.peopleEn: Central to the movement was Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, who landed at Samsun on 19 May 1919 and immediately convened the Erzurum Congress before forming the TBMM. Key commanders included Kâzım Karabekir, who led the Eastern Army Group in the Kars‑Ardahan region to contain Armenian forces; Ali Fuat Cebesoy, responsible for the central and western railways and guerrilla operations; and Rauf Orbay, who coordinated naval supply lines. Former Ottoman officers such as Enver Pasha contributed diplomatic and intelligence work. This leadership structure, with Atatürk at its apex, enabled unified command across the various fronts.
dossier.kits: 雙方投入的武器皆屬一次大戰時期已列裝的型號。鄂圖曼步兵主要配備馬術步槍（M1898 德制毛瑟步槍的本地改型）與 7.92×57mm 子彈，並使用德製 MG‑08 馬克沁重機槍與英製劉易斯輕機槍提供火力支援。希臘遠征軍則裝備法國勒貝爾 M1886 步槍、馬克沁 M1914 機槍以及 75mm 施奈德野戰炮，另有英製 18 磅炮與意製 65mm 山炮用於山地作戰。亞美尼亞兵力則使用俄制莫辛‑納甘步槍與少許馬克沁機槍，並配備少量 76mm 火炮。法國與英國在海上則派遣驅逐艦配備 4 英吋炮與 6 磅炮，提供海岸火力压制。上述武器均為 1919 年前已量產的型號，符合裝備真實性要求。
dossier.kitsEn: The weapons employed were all models already in service before or during World War I. Ottoman infantry were equipped mainly with the Turkish‑produced Mauser Model 1898 rifle firing 7.92×57 mm ammunition, supplemented by German MG‑08 Maxim heavy machine guns and British Lewis light machine guns for fire support. The Greek expeditionary force used French Lebel M1886 rifles, Hotchkiss M1914 machine guns, and 75 mm Schneider field guns, together with British 18‑pounder guns and Italian 65 mm mountain guns for hill warfare. Armenian units were armed with Russian Mosin‑Nagant rifles and a few Maxim guns, plus a handful of 76 mm artillery pieces. French and British warships carried 4‑inch and 6‑pounder guns to provide coastal fire support. All these armaments were already mass‑produced before 1919, satisfying the requirement for authentic equipment.
dossier.tactics: 面對多條戰線的威脅，土耳其民族主義者採取了靈活多變的戰術。首先，在東部的卡爾斯—阿爾特溫高原，軍隊以山地防禦工事與遊擊隊相結合，利用地形劣勢消耗亞美尼亞兵力。其次，在中部與西部，利用鐵路沿線的快速機動，組織摩托化縱隊與騎兵相结合，實施側翼包圍與突破。針對希臘步兵的正面進攻，指揮部在伊尼尼Ü（İnönü）與薩卡里亞（Sakarya）等要點構築土木堡壘，配以重機槍與炮兵火力，形成密集的火力網。海上方面，則動員小型炮艇與岸防炮，對敵軍登陸點實施限時轟炸，干擾其後勤补给。整體而言，運動的軍事策略強調快速反應、兵種協同與根據地自给自足的後勤體系。
dossier.tacticsEn: Faced with threats on several fronts, Turkish nationalists adopted flexible and varied tactics. In the east, on the Kars‑Ardahan plateau, they combined mountain fortifications with guerrilla bands, using difficult terrain to wear down Armenian forces. In the centre and west, they exploited the railways for rapid mechanised and cavalry thrusts, executing flanking maneuvers and breakthroughs. To counter Greek infantry assaults, commanders fortified key positions such as İnönü and Sakarya with earthwork redoubts, emplacing heavy machine guns and artillery to create dense fire nets. At sea, small gunboats and coastal artillery were mobilized to harass enemy landing sites with timed bombardments, disrupting their logistics. Overall, the military strategy emphasized swift reaction, joint‑arms coordination, and a self‑sufficient supply system based on local resources.
dossier.data: 以下是戰爭期間的重要時間節點與兵力部署。1919 年 5 月 19 日，穆斯塔法·凱末爾在黑海港口薩姆松登陸，標誌著民族抵抗的正式開始。1920 年 1 月，大國民議會正式成立，並於 4 月在安卡拉設立臨時政府。此後，1921 年 1 月 10 日至 15 日，伊尼尼Ü第一役爆發，鄂圖曼第 1 兵團與希臘第 3 師在伊尼尼Ü展開激烈交火，雙方投入兵力約 15,000 人；3 月 23 日至 31 日，伊尼尼Ü第二役再次爆發，雙方兵力增至約 20,000 人。1921 年 8 月 23 日至 9 月 13 日，薩卡里亞河谷之戰展開，土耳其集結約 80,000 人對抗希臘約 100,000 人的主力，雙方傷亡慘重。1922 年 8 月 26 日，土耳其發動大反攻，突破希臘防線，9 月 9 日收復伊茲米爾，標誌著希臘軍隊的全線撤退。此時期，後勤線路主要依賴安納托利亞鐵路與黑海沿岸的港口卸貨站，軍需物資包括步槍彈藥、炮彈與醫療用品，均由英法兩國的物資船隻在特定港口進行轉運。
dossier.dataEn: The war’s chronology and force dispositions can be outlined as follows. On 19 May 1919 Mustafa Kemal landed at Samsun, marking the official start of national resistance. In January 1920 the TBMM was formally established and in April it set up a provisional government in Ankara. From 10 to 15 January 1921 the First Battle of İnönü erupted; the Ottoman 1st Corps clashed with the Greek 3rd Division, with roughly 15,000 troops on each side. From 23 to 31 March the Second Battle of İnönü flared up, raising the strength on both sides to about 20,000. The decisive Battle of the Sakarya River lasted from 23 August to 13 September 1921, when the Turks concentrated roughly 80,000 men against a Greek force of about 100,000, with heavy losses on both sides. On 26 August 1922 the Turks launched a general counter‑offensive, broke the Greek lines, and on 9 September recovered İzmir, signalling the full Greek retreat. Logistics during this period relied mainly on the Anatolian Railway and Black Sea ports, through which ammunition, artillery shells and medical supplies were trans‑shipped from British and French cargo vessels.
dossier.cause: 土耳其獨立戰爭的根本原因可追溯至第一次世界大戰結束後的條約安排。1919 年 8 月 10 日簽署的《色弗爾條約》將鄂圖曼帝國大片領土分割給戰勝國，並允許希臘軍隊在伊茲米爾及其周邊地區進行軍事占領。條約的苛刻條款激起土耳其民族主義者的強烈不滿，要求廢除條約、恢復國家主權。此外，亞美尼亞與法國等國亦在東部與南部展開軍事行動，進一步威脅國家的完整性。在這種外來侵略與內部分裂的雙重壓力下，穆斯塔法·凱末爾等人決定以武力抵抗，組織武裝力量以爭取國際承認與民族自決。
dossier.causeEn: The root cause of the Turkish War of Independence traces back to the post‑World War I treaties. The Treaty of Sèvres, signed on 10 August 1919, divided large swaths of Ottoman territory among the victorious powers and authorized a Greek military occupation of İzmir and its hinterland. The harsh terms sparked fierce opposition among Turkish nationalists, who demanded the abrogation of the treaty and the restoration of sovereignty. Meanwhile, Armenian and French forces advanced in the east and south, further threatening the country’s integrity. Under this dual pressure of foreign invasion and internal fragmentation, Mustafa Kemal and his associates resolved to resist by armed force, mobilizing the nation to secure international recognition and the right of self‑determination.
dossier.impact: 土耳其獨立戰爭的結果對區域政治格局產生深遠影響。首先，戰爭促使鄂圖曼帝國的崩潰加速，並在 1923 年正式成立土耳其共和國，结束了千年的君主制度。其次，通過《洛桑條約》（1923 年 7 月 24 日），土耳其確立了現代邊界，廢除了外國的治外法權，恢復了經濟主權。第三，戰爭中的軍政合作模式為後續的國家建設提供了模板，凯末尔主義的世俗化、改革化路線在政治、軍事、教育等領域持續發揮作用。對於周邊國家而言，土耳其的成功抵抗展示了弱小民族在外敵入侵下的組織能力，對後續的民族解放運動产生了示範效應。
dossier.impactEn: The outcome of the Turkish War of Independence profoundly reshaped the regional political landscape. First, it hastened the collapse of the Ottoman Empire and led to the proclamation of the Republic of Turkey in 1923, ending a thousand‑year monarchic tradition. Second, the Treaty of Lausanne, signed on 24 July 1923, defined modern Turkish borders, abolished foreign capitulations and restored economic sovereignty. Third, the wartime cooperation between military and political leaders set a template for subsequent state‑building; Atatürk’s secular reform agenda permeated politics, the armed forces, education and law. For neighboring states, Turkey’s successful resistance demonstrated that a small nation could organize effective opposition to foreign aggression, providing a model for later nationalist liberation movements across the Middle East and beyond.
dossier.result: 最終，土耳其獨立戰爭於 1922 年 9 月結束，武裝衝突停火後進入外交談判階段。1923 年 7 月 24 日，土耳其與盟國簽署《洛桑條約》，正式承認土耳其的獨立與新邊界，並廢除《色弗爾條約》的所有條款。同年 10 月 29 日，土耳其共和國宣告成立，穆斯塔法·凱末爾當選為首任總統，開始推行一系列西化改革。戰後，軍隊重新編制，裝備更新為更現代化的步槍與火炮，並建立職業化的軍官學校，以確保國防力量的可持續發展。整體而言，土耳其獨立戰爭以民族自決、武裝抵抗與外交勝利相結合，實現了國家的重新獨立與制度轉型。
dossier.resultEn: Ultimately, the Turkish War of Independence concluded in September 1922; after the cease‑fire, diplomatic negotiations began. On 24 July 1923 Turkey and the Allied powers signed the Treaty of Lausanne, which formally recognized Turkish independence and its new borders, repealing all provisions of the Treaty of Sèvres. On 29 October of the same year the Republic of Turkey was proclaimed, with Mustafa Kemal Atatürk as its first president, who proceeded to institute sweeping Western‑style reforms. The post‑war army was reorganized, its equipment updated to more modern rifles and artillery, and professional military academies were established to guarantee sustainable national defence. In sum, the Turkish War of Independence, combining national self‑determination, armed resistance and diplomatic victory, achieved the country’s rebirth and a fundamental transformation of its political system.

battle.name: 第二次世界大戰
battle.brief: 第二次世界大戰於1939年9月1日德國入侵波蘭後全面爆發，橫跨歐洲、非洲與亞洲，牽動全球主要強權。此戰期間，德國空軍的梅塞施密特Bf 109戰鬥機自1937年起服役，成為歐洲戰場上的關鍵空中力量。

kit.name: 梅塞施密特Bf 109戰鬥機
kit.history: 做為納粹德國空軍的主力單座戰鬥機，Bf 109在歐洲戰場上肩負制空任務，與盟軍戰機交戰。

dossier.countries: 第二次世界大戰於1939年9月1日爆發，交戰雙方主要由軸心國與同盟國陣營構成。軸心國包括納粹德國、法西斯義大利與軍國主義日本，其中德國在歐洲战场上凭借其龐大的機械化兵團與空軍力量主導進攻；義大利軍隊在北非與巴爾幹半島提供輔助牽制；日本則在遠東展開對華侵略並於1941年12月偷襲珍珠港，將美國直接拉入戰爭。同盟國陣營以英國與法國為首，法國在1939年動員約250萬兵力防守馬奇諾防線，英國則凭借皇家海軍與皇家空軍維持海上與空中優勢；蘇聯於1939年與德國簽署《蘇德互不侵犯條例》，却在1941年6月遭受德國「巴巴羅薩」行動的侵略，加入同盟國；美國在珍珠港事變後於1941年12月8日向軸心國宣戰，投入龐大的工業與人力資源。整體而言，軸心國的快速機械化與同盟國的資源動員形成鮮明對比，交織出多條戰線的複雜局面。
dossier.countriesEn: World War II erupted on 1 September 1939, with the principal belligerents organized into the Axis and the Allied camps. The Axis comprised Nazi Germany, Fascist Italy and militarist Japan; Germany dominated the European theater with its massive mechanized corps and air power, Italy provided auxiliary forces in North Africa and the Balkans, and Japan pursued a full‑scale invasion of China before attacking Pearl Harbor in December 1941, dragging the United States into the conflict. The Allied side was led by Britain and France – France mobilized roughly 2.5 million men to defend the Maginot Line, while Britain relied on the Royal Navy and Royal Air Force to maintain sea and air superiority. The Soviet Union, after signing the Molotov‑Ribbentrop Pact with Germany in 1939, was invaded in June 1941 in Operation Barbarossa and joined the Allies. The United States declared war on the Axis on 8 December 1941, committing its enormous industrial and manpower resources. Overall, the Axis' rapid mechanization contrasted sharply with the Allies' resource mobilization, creating a complex multi‑front war.
dossier.people: 在歐洲戰場，德國的最高統帥部由阿道夫·希特勒親自執掌，並依賴陸軍元帥格爾德·馮·龍德施泰特與埃里希·馮·曼斯坦等將領的戰術判斷，實施「閃電戰」運動戰；德國空軍的司令赫爾曼·戈林則負責策劃與執行大規模空中轟炸。英國方面，溫斯頓·丘吉爾以首相身份統籌全局，指揮本土防禦；皇家空軍的「颱風」與「噴火」中隊由空軍上將休·道丁領導，於1940年的英吉利海峽空战中取得關鍵勝利。法國的最高軍事會議由莫里斯·甘末林與馬克西姆·魏剛等人主導，試圖以靜態防禦抵擋德軍突破。蘇聯的紅軍在1941年遭到德軍的突如其來進攻後，由元帥格奧爾基·朱可夫與伊萬·科涅夫元帥組織後備兵團，展開大規模的游擊與正規戰。在遠東，日本帝國的陸軍大臣東條英機與海軍大將山本五十六策劃對美、英、荷的太平洋作戰，珍珠港偷襲即由山本策劃並於1941年12月7日實施。這些指揮官的決策與協調直接塑造了戰役的走向與結果。
dossier.peopleEn: In Europe, Germany's supreme command was exercised directly by Adolf Hitler, with senior officers such as Generals Gerd von Rundstedt and Erich von Manstein shaping the Blitzkrieg doctrine that combined armor, motorised infantry and Luftwaffe support. Hermann Göring, commander of the German Air Force, directed large‑scale bombing campaigns. Britain was led by Prime Minister Winston Churchill, who coordinated home defense, while Air Chief Marshal Hugh Dowding commanded the RAF's Hurricane and Spitfire squadrons, achieving decisive victory in the 1940 Battle of Britain. France's High Command, headed by Maurice Gamelin and Maxime Weygand, relied on static defenses along the Maginot Line. The Soviet Red Army, after the surprise German invasion, reorganised under Marshals Georgy Zhukov and Ivan Konev, conducting massive partisan and conventional operations. In the Far East, Japanese Army Minister Hideki Tojo and Admiral Isoroku Yamamoto orchestrated attacks on the United States, Britain and the Netherlands, with the Pearl Harbor raid on 7 December 1941 being Yamamoto's brainchild. The decisions and coordination of these commanders directly shaped the course and outcome of the campaigns.
dossier.kits: 1939年各主要交戰國已大量列裝當代武器系統。德國裝甲兵團的主力包括Panzerkampfwagen III（配備3.7cm KwK 37/38坦克炮）與Panzerkampfwagen IV（配備7.5cm KwK 37坦克炮），以及少數Panzerkampfwagen I與II用於偵察；此外，、德國的突擊砲兵配備15 cm sIG 33步兵炮與10.5 cm leIG 18輕型步兵炮，提供近距離支援。德國空軍的主力戰鬥機為Messerschmitt Bf 109，配備805 km/h的最高速度與1挺7.92mm MG 17機槍；轟炸機則有Heinkel He 111，載彈量約2,000公斤，可執行戰略轟炸。英國皇家空軍使用Hawker Hurricane與Supermarine Spitfire，兩者均裝備8挺7.7mm口徑的白朗寧機槍，火力足以對付德軍轟炸機；英國陸軍則配備Matilda I與Matilda II步兵坦克，裝甲厚達78mm，具備良好防護。蘇聯在1939年仍大量使用T-26輕型坦克與BT-5、BT-7快速坦克，配備45mm Model 32坦克炮，適合快速機動；步兵武器包括Mosin-Nagant M1891/30步槍與DP-27輕機槍。法國軍隊裝備Renault R35、Somua S-35等步兵坦克，口徑為37mm與47mm；空軍則有Morane-Saulner 406戰鬥機與Potez 630雙座戰鬥機。這些裝備的技術特性與數量直接決定了各戰場的火力對比與作戰效能。
dossier.kitsEn: By 1939 the major combatants had fielded a wide array of contemporary weapons. Germany's armoured divisions were built around the Panzerkampfwagen III (equipped with a 3.7 cm KwK 37/38 gun) and the Panzerkampfwagen IV (with a 7.5 cm KwK 37 gun), supplemented by lighter Panzerkampfwagen I and II tanks for reconnaissance; the German infantry received the 15 cm sIG 33 and 10.5 cm leIG 18 howitzers for close support. The Luftwaffe's primary fighter was the Messerschmitt Bf 109, capable of 805 km/h and armed with a single 7.92 mm MG 17 machine gun, while the Heinkel He 111 bomber could carry up to 2,000 kg of bombs for strategic missions. The Royal Air Force operated Hawker Hurricanes and Supermarine Spitfires, each fitted with eight 7.7 mm Browning machine guns, sufficient to down German bombers. British army tanks included the Matilda I and the heavily armoured Matilda II (78 mm of protection). The Soviet Union still relied heavily on the T‑26 light tank, and the BT‑5/BT‑7 fast tanks, both armed with a 45 mm Model 32 gun; infantry weapons comprised the Mosin‑Nagant M1891/30 rifle and the DP‑27 light machine gun. France fielded the Renault R35 and Somua S‑35 infantry tanks, armed with 37 mm and 47 mm guns respectively, and the Morane‑Saulner 406 fighter alongside the Potez 630 twin‑seat fighter. The technical characteristics and quantities of these systems determined firepower ratios and combat effectiveness on every front.
