China did not counterattack simultaneously along the entire city boundary; it held the Nineteenth Route Army on the Hongqiao–Zhabei–Wusong–Baoshan–Jiangwan line, using field fortifications, machine-gun nests, mortars, and 75-mm guns as mutually supporting strongpoints. When a flank was attacked, the front line called for help by telephone or runner, and reserves came forward along roads behind the line to make short counterattacks. In later phases, Japan used landing forces to cut in from the flank and rear, naval guns to suppress Chinese artillery, and aircraft to reconnoiter and strike military positions and supply roads. Chinese troops used the terrain to reestablish positions at night and cut off isolated Japanese outposts. As the front lengthened, local counterattacks often could not become a general counteroffensive because ammunition and communications support arrived too slowly.
dossier.data: 日期、路線和編制可以整理成一條較清楚的時間線。1931年11月28日，上海北部日軍與中國守軍交火；十二月下旬起，日本增兵和海軍協同使前線壓力增加；1932年1月上旬，新的師團到達後，日軍在寶山、吳淞、江灣、虹橋等方向反覆試圖切斷中方南北通道，1月28日前後再次發動大規模攻勢；1月31日停火，2月18日簽署協定。中方作戰序列以第十九路軍為主，中央軍第五軍等後續到達；日方作戰序列以上海派遣軍為統帥，師團與海軍陸戰隊、艦隊及航空隊分開指揮但協同作戰。前線北接長江口吳淞，東西連接閘北、虹橋與江灣，後方物資先由南京沿滬寧鐵路到上海，再以汽車、船舶或畜力車分送各陣地。各方兵力、彈藥消耗和傷亡數字並沒有同一套可靠總表，因此可列日期與編制，不能把估算的傷亡數字當成精確事實。
dossier.dataEn: Dates, routes, and formations can be arranged as a clear timeline. On November 28, 1931, Japanese and Chinese troops clashed in northern Shanghai. During late December, Japanese reinforcements and naval cooperation increased pressure on the front. In early January 1932, additional divisions arrived, and Japanese attacks repeatedly sought to cut China's north–south routes at Baoshan, Wusong, Jiangwan, and Hongqiao; around January 28, Japan launched another major offensive. Fighting stopped on January 31, and the agreement was signed on February 18. The Chinese order of battle centered on the Nineteenth Route Army, with Central Army units such as the Fifth Army arriving later. Japan's Shanghai Expeditionary Army formed the higher command, while divisions, the naval landing force, warships, and aviation retained separate chains of command but operated together. The front ran from Wusong at the Yangtze mouth through Zhabei, Hongqiao, and Jiangwan. Supplies moved first from Nanjing to Shanghai by the Shanghai–Nanjing Railway, then by motor vehicle, ship, or animal-drawn cart to the positions. No single reliable total exists for the troops, ammunition consumption, or casualties on all sides, so dates and formations can be stated, but estimated casualty figures should not be presented as exact facts.
dossier.cause: 直接原因並非一個毫無爭議的單一事件，而是1931年日本在東北得手後，上海軍政權力出現連續摩擦。日本陸軍要求中國軍隊撤退，並為上海衝突道歉；中國政府拒絕後，日本以海軍陸戰隊和增兵施加壓力，談判逐漸被火砲取代。十一月下旬的觸發經過，中日兩方留下的說法並不相同：日方說中國軍警攻擊日本哨位，中方說日本部隊先以武裝封鎖和挑釁方式迫使守軍後退。兩種說法都涉及軍隊的權限和直接接觸，不能簡化為孤立的口頭爭執。更深的背景，是日本試圖把東北形成的壓力延伸到上海，而國民政府仍要保有上海防務與國家主權；第十九路軍奉命駐紮，遂成為日軍選擇的主要對手。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate cause was not a single event that could be treated as uncontested. After Japan's military success in Northeast China in 1931, friction over military and political authority continued in Shanghai. The Japanese Army demanded that Chinese troops withdraw and that China apologize for the clash. After the Chinese government refused, Japan applied pressure with the naval landing force and reinforcements, and negotiation was gradually replaced by artillery fire. Accounts of the late-November trigger differ: Japan said Chinese security forces attacked a Japanese post, while China said Japanese troops first used armed obstruction and provocation to force the defenders back. Both accounts concern military authority and direct contact, so the incident cannot be reduced to an isolated verbal dispute. The deeper background was Japan's attempt to extend the pressure created by its position in Northeast China to Shanghai, while the Nationalist government still intended to retain control of Shanghai's defense and national sovereignty. The Nineteenth Route Army was stationed there and consequently became the principal opponent selected by Japan.
dossier.impact: 戰役的第一個直接影響，是上海北部的控制與補給線都發生了變化。日軍把新增師團、艦砲、航空隊和登陸部隊結合起來，使中國守軍在吳淞、寶山、江灣、虹橋一線的若干陣地失守或必須後撤；第十九路軍原有的固定防線被切斷成數段，中央軍第五軍等增援只能在有限時間內重新佈置。與此同時，停戰線成為新的軍事邊界，雙方在線外仍保留兵員和火力，外國租界的存在使上海形成分隔的武裝區。這場戰鬥也讓南京更清楚看到中央軍調度、地方軍作戰、砲兵火力與海空協同之間的差距；第十九路軍因長期抵抗而取得政治聲望，但聲望不等於補給線恢復，也不等於陣地全部守住。各方對傷亡總數的記載互相矛盾，本文只確認作戰時間、部隊番號和武器類型，不列無法核實的精確傷亡。
dossier.impactEn: The first direct effect was that control and supply lines in northern Shanghai changed. Japan combined newly arriving divisions, naval gunfire, aviation, and landing troops, forcing Chinese defenders to lose or abandon some positions along Wusong, Baoshan, Jiangwan, and Hongqiao, and breaking the original fixed defense of the Nineteenth Route Army into separate sections. Central Army reinforcements such as the Fifth Army could redeploy only within a limited time. At the same time, the ceasefire line became a new military boundary, both sides still kept troops and firepower outside it, and the existence of the foreign concessions left Shanghai divided into armed zones. The fighting also showed Nanjing the gap between Central Army mobilization, local army operations, artillery fire, and naval-air cooperation. The Nineteenth Route Army gained political prestige through its prolonged resistance, but prestige did not restore supply lines or hold every position. Records of total casualties conflict; this account confirms only the dates, unit designations, and weapon types and does not give an unverifiable precise casualty figure.
dossier.result: 到了1932年1月下旬，日軍把後續到達的師團投入寶山、吳淞、江灣與閘北方向，並以艦砲和航空隊支援連續攻擊；中方第五軍等增援雖曾填補部分防線缺口，但前線經反覆消耗，通信、彈藥補給和側翼反擊未能同時維持，最終只能依停火命令退出部分陣地。1月31日雙方停止大規模交火，實際控制線被固定在上海北部若干要點之間，並非日軍完全占領上海，也不是中國軍隊收復全部失地。2月18日簽訂的《上海停戰協定》把停火、駐軍區和撤軍安排寫入文本，日軍依協定分批撤出或調整占領區，中國軍隊也調整了部署。這就是事件的軍事結局：一場以停火和分區控制收束、而非以全面殲滅或全面收復收束的戰役；其傷亡總數仍不宜用單一精確數字概括。
dossier.resultEn: By late January 1932, Japan committed the divisions that had arrived later to the Baoshan, Wusong, Jiangwan, and Zhabei directions and supported repeated attacks with naval guns and aircraft. Chinese reinforcements such as the Fifth Army did fill some gaps, but after repeated operations the front could not maintain communications, ammunition supply, and flank counterattacks at the same time; Chinese troops eventually withdrew from some positions under the ceasefire order. On January 31, both sides stopped large-scale fighting, and the actual line of control was fixed among several points in northern Shanghai. Japan did not occupy all of Shanghai, nor did the Chinese army recover every lost position. The Shanghai Truce Agreement signed on February 18 set out ceasefires, garrison zones, and withdrawal arrangements. Japan withdrew from or adjusted occupied areas in stages under the agreement, and the Chinese army also revised its deployments. Thus the military ending was a ceasefire and partition of control, not annihilation on one side or full reconquest by the other; the total casualties still cannot responsibly be reduced to one precise number.

battle.name: 查科戰爭
battle.theater: 格蘭查科荒漠與沼澤地帶
battle.brief: 查科戰爭（1932‑1935）是玻利維亞與巴拉圭在格蘭查科荒漠與沼澤地帶的武裝衝突，雙方軍隊均裝備英國授權製造的維克斯.303水冷式機槍，該槍於1912年服役，並在激烈前線中發揮關鍵火力支援。

kit.name: 維克斯.303水冷式機槍
kit.history: 作為英國軍的標準中型機槍，維克斯.303在一次大戰與後續衝突中被廣泛使用，以其水冷式結構提供持續火力支援，成為步兵與火力支援的主力裝備。

dossier.countries: 交戰國為巴拉圭與玻利維亞，戰場集中在兩國之間的查科地區。巴拉圭的軍事目標是沿查科南部建立較靠近巴拉圭河的安全邊界，並鞏固從阿松森通往北方哨站的路線；玻利維亞則力圖在北部取得足以控制上游航道與邊防的區域。這不是一條天然清楚的界線，兩國引用不同的殖民時期文件，對河道源頭、島嶼及內陸分水嶺各有解讀。地形由南向北逐步低平，遍布喬木林、灌木、河曲、積水與季節性泥濘，築路和運補往往比正面射擊更能決定戰局。
dossier.countriesEn: The belligerents were Paraguay and Bolivia, and the fighting was concentrated in the Chaco between them. Paraguay’s military objective was to establish a security boundary closer to the Paraguay River along the southern Chaco and secure the route from Asunción to northern outposts; Bolivia sought to obtain an area in the north sufficient to control the upper navigation route and frontier defense. The boundary was not a naturally clear line. The two states cited different colonial-era documents and interpreted river sources, islands, and inland watersheds differently. The land slopes gradually toward lower ground from south to north and is covered with woodland, scrub, river bends, standing water, and seasonal mud. Road construction and sustainment therefore often mattered more to the course of the battle than frontal fire.
dossier.people: 一九三二年開戰時，玻利維亞由恩里克．佩納蘭達總統兼陸軍最高指揮官主持戰局，他持續徵召與整編，並把鐵路運輸和糧秣列為優先工作。北部的主要作戰先後由何塞．費利克斯．布蘭科將軍統率；他後來又在阿巴波主持反攻。一九三二年十一月攻擊普韋爾托布斯科堡時，陸軍中校塞韋羅．費爾南德斯率領突擊縱隊，陣亡後該堡以他命名。巴拉圭由參謀長何塞．費利克斯．埃斯蒂加里瓦將軍籌劃全線攻勢，之後又直接統率北部增援與突破。何塞．阿古斯丁．恩西索中將指揮第二師，其部隊在克拉拉薩受困被俘，而後續部隊在馬里薩爾埃斯蒂加里瓦完成戰術突圍。
dossier.peopleEn: When war began in 1932, President and Army supreme commander Enrique Peñaranda directed Bolivia’s war effort, continuing mobilization and consolidation while giving priority to rail transport and supplies. Major operations in the north were at various stages commanded by General José Félix Blanco, who later led the counterattack at Abapó. During the assault on Puerto Busch in November 1932, Lieutenant Colonel Severo Fernández led the strike force; after his death, the fort was renamed in his honor. Paraguay’s offensive across the entire front was planned by Chief of Staff General José Félix Estigarriba, who later personally commanded reinforcements and relief operations in the north. Major General José Agustín Enciso commanded the Second Division, whose troops were surrounded and captured at Clarazá, while a following force achieved a tactical breakout at Mariscal Estigarriba.
dossier.kits: 前線火力以栓動步槍、七五毫米野戰炮及一〇五毫米榴彈炮為核心。玻利維亞步兵可見Krueger M1904式舊步槍，並配用施耐德75毫米山地炮M1907/36；巴拉圭大量使用7.65×53.5毫米Mauser M1895步槍，雙方再以重機槍、輕機槍和迫擊炮補射界與林間目標。少量Schneider CA1與Vickers 6噸戰車多依賴公路，自重、履帶、涉水與散熱在雨季限制行動；巴拉圭亦使用Vickers 6噸系列。航空方面，玻利維亞投入Curtiss F11C-2 Hawk II、Curtiss P-36A Hawk與Douglas O-38系列，巴拉圭使用Martin 2T-1B Master及Dornier Merklin，這些型號均在一九三二年以前已經列裝。
dossier.kitsEn: Front-line firepower centered on bolt-action rifles, 75 mm field guns, and 105 mm howitzers. Bolivian infantry included the older Krueger Model 1904 rifle and used the Schneider 75 mm mountain gun Model 1907/36; Paraguay extensively used 7.65 × 53.5 mm Mauser Model 1895 rifles, while both sides supplemented them with heavy and light machine guns and mortars. Small numbers of Schneider CA1 and Vickers 6-Ton tanks depended heavily on roads, with weight, tracks, water crossings, and cooling limiting movement during the rainy season; Paraguay also operated vehicles from the Vickers 6-Ton series. In aviation, Bolivia employed the Curtiss F11C-2 Hawk II, Curtiss P-36A Hawk, and Douglas O-38 series, while Paraguay used the Martin 2T-1B Master and Dornier Merklin. All of these types had entered service before 1932.
dossier.tactics: 一九三二年五月二十九日，巴拉圭在拂曉以炮火準備打開約一百七十公里的接觸正面，步兵不排成連續攻擊線，而以分散縱隊沿林間小徑與河岸通道推進，使玻利維亞無法及時連繫的孤立哨所逐個陷落。七月至九月，玻利維亞把一個師的集中兵力投入科拉萊斯方向，反覆攻擊道路交會處與林木間高地，但巴拉圭守軍及反擊迫使它退回。十一月一日至三日，玻利維亞突擊縱隊攻向普韋爾托布斯科堡，十一月二十九日前後的外圍攻勢受挫後，堡內守軍於三日被逐出，雖然取得巴拉圭河畔的立足點，卻沒有立即建立可持續向南方輸送的補給線。一九三三年一月十七日至十八日，玻利維亞依次奪取納納瓦與納納瓦拉古納，巴拉圭四月四日的反擊未能收復該地。三月克拉拉薩一帶，恩西索所率第二師被包圍後投降；八月底至九月初，埃斯蒂加里瓦率增援縱隊在馬里薩爾埃斯蒂加里瓦突破包圍。一九三四年，巴拉圭先在亞卡雷取得突破，隨後通過伊維庫伊，進抵卡阿庫佩、卡拉佩瓜及布魯埃斯將軍鎮一線，但三月二十七日阿巴波戰鬥阻止深入。從此雙方沿主要道路和河道構築縱深陣地，進行炮兵射擊、空中巡邏與小規模突擊，直至停火。
dossier.tacticsEn: At dawn on 29 May 1932, Paraguay opened the fighting with an artillery preparation across an active front roughly 170 kilometers wide. Instead of forming a continuous assault line, its infantry advanced in dispersed columns along woodland tracks and riverbank paths, isolating Bolivian outposts that could not be reduced directly. From July through September, Bolivia concentrated a division toward Corrales and repeatedly attacked track junctions and wooded high ground, but Paraguayan defenses and counterattacks forced it back. Between 1 and 3 November, a Bolivian strike force moved against Puerto Busch; after an unsuccessful attempt around the perimeter, the defenders were driven out on the third. The capture provided a foothold on the Paraguay River but did not immediately create a sustainable supply route into the south. On 17 and 18 January 1933, Bolivia took Nanawa and Nanawa Laguna in succession, while a Paraguayan counterattack on 4 April failed to recover them. At Clarazá in March, Enciso’s Second Division was surrounded and captured; between late August and early September, Estigarriba led a reinforcing column to break out at Mariscal Estigarriba. In 1934, Paraguay first broke through at Yacare and then advanced through Ybycuí toward Caacupé, Carapeguá, and General Bruguéz, but the Battle of Abapó on 27 March prevented further penetration. Thereafter, both sides constructed depth positions along the principal roads and waterways and conducted artillery fire, aerial patrols, and limited local attacks until the ceasefire.
dossier.data: 兵力資料必須區分前線實數與全國可動員總數。常見軍史估計把一九三二年五月可調兵員列為巴拉圭約三萬人、玻利維亞約一萬四千人；至停火前，玻利維亞總動員通常估為二十萬至二十五萬人，巴拉圭約十五萬人。這些數字包括後方、預備與輪替部隊，不能直接當作同一日期的作戰兵力。巴拉圭的運補主軸是亞松森至卡阿庫佩的鐵路，再由600毫米Decauville輕便鐵路向布魯埃斯將軍鎮及北方哨堡延伸；玻利維亞則由拉巴斯經奧魯羅、烏尤尼與阿托查，再以公路接維拉蒙特斯及Cuatro Ciudades，另一條補給線由聖克魯斯鐵路通往亞庫阿雷與波爾通。七五毫米高爆榴彈、機槍彈鏈和手榴彈先由火車、貨車送至後方終點，再用馬匹和人力分送砲位；燃料、輪胎、備件、糧食與醫療用品同樣受到運輸距離限制。雨季道路泥濘、瘧疾與腸道疾病又妨礙輪替和長期駐紮，因此本文不把來源互不一致的精確傷亡數字視為定論。
dossier.dataEn: Military figures must distinguish troops actually at the front from the national pools available for mobilization. Common military-history estimates place Paraguay’s forces available in May 1932 at about 30,000 men and Bolivia’s at about 14,000; by the ceasefire, total mobilization is generally estimated at roughly 200,000 to 250,000 for Bolivia and about 150,000 for Paraguay. These totals included rear-area, reserve, and replacement troops and cannot be treated as simultaneous combat strength. Paraguay’s main supply axis ran by rail from Asunción to Caacupé, followed by a 600 mm Decauville light railway toward General Bruguéz and the northern outposts. Bolivia used a route through La Paz, Oruro, Uyuni, and Atocha, followed by road transport to Villamontes and Cuatro Ciudades; another supply line ran from the Santa Cruz railway toward Yacuare and Portón. Seventy-five-millimeter high-explosive shells, machine-gun belts, and grenades were carried first by train and truck to rear depots and then distributed to gun positions by pack animals and manpower; fuel, tires, spare parts, food, and medical supplies were constrained by the same distances. Muddy rainy-season roads, malaria, and intestinal disease further disrupted rotation and prolonged occupation, so disputed single totals for battle casualties are not treated here as established fact.
dossier.cause: 衝突的直接源頭，是兩國對邊界測量與解釋長期不一致。十九世紀留下的地圖、河川資料，以及一八七〇年《洛伊薩加－科特希佩條約》和一八七四年《阿亞喬喬條約》所形成的邊界安排，從未產生雙方都接受的查科界線。玻利維亞把北查科視為阻止內陸軍力與道路向巴拉圭河伸展的屏障，巴拉圭則擔心玻利維亞哨堡及後方道路逐步逼近主要河運帶。兩國在一九三一年前後曾談判並嘗試組織邊界委員會，但未形成共同方案；巴伊亞內格拉與中部前哨的巡邏、封鎖和零星交火隨之增加。當地方事件不再局限於小隊接觸，雙方把控制水井、渡口和道路節點視為鞏固邊界的實際手段，地方衝突遂擴大成全面戰爭。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate source of the conflict was a long-standing disagreement over boundary surveying and legal interpretation. Colonial maps, river records, and the frontier arrangements associated with the 1870 Treaty of Loizaga-Cotegipe and the 1874 Treaty of Ayacucho never produced a Chaco boundary accepted by both states. Bolivia regarded the northern Chaco as a buffer preventing inland military roads and forces from extending toward the Paraguay River, while Paraguay feared that Bolivian outposts and rear-area roads would progressively approach its principal river corridor. Around 1931 the two governments negotiated and attempted to organize a boundary commission, but no common settlement followed; patrols, blockades, and isolated exchanges of fire increased around Bahía Negra and the central outposts. Once local incidents were no longer limited to small-unit contact, each side treated control of wells, crossings, and road junctions as the practical means of securing its frontier, expanding the confrontation into general war.
dossier.impact: 從一九三四年延續到一九三五年的僵局顯示，能突破前線不等於能持續佔領土地。巴拉圭雖曾深入玻利維亞控制區超過一百公里，但道路、鐵路與空運沒有同步前伸，縱隊分散後，貨車、馬匹飼料、燃料和備件難以跟上。空軍可以偵察和襲擊，卻受跑道、炸藥、燃油與維修能力限制；少量戰車常因泥濘、履帶故障和涉水問題停在道路附近。巴拉圭占據較多南部陣地，玻利維亞則保住北部，並以更長的鐵路與公路後方線進行反擊。長期駐防受到疾病、飲水、草料及輪替效率限制，任何一方都難以再集中力量發動具有決定效果的新攻勢。戰後兩國都擴大後備與工程編制，把道路、橋梁、無線電、航空和裝備維修納入軍隊計畫；巴拉圭獲得較有利的軍事位置，玻利維亞則重新調整裝甲、機械化與空軍快速取勝的方案。
dossier.impactEn: The stalemate from 1934 into 1935 showed that breaking the front did not automatically permit an army to occupy and supply captured ground. Paraguay advanced more than 100 kilometers into Bolivian-held territory, but roads, railways, and air transport did not extend at the same rate. Once its columns dispersed, trucks, pack-animal fodder, fuel, and spare parts could not keep pace. Aircraft could reconnoiter and attack, yet airfields, explosives, fuel, and maintenance imposed limits; the small tank force repeatedly stopped near roads because of mud, track failures, and water crossings. Paraguay occupied a larger share of the southern positions, while Bolivia retained the north and used its longer railway and road network for counterattacks. Prolonged occupation was constrained by disease, water, fodder, and the efficiency of troop rotation, making it difficult for either state to concentrate for another decisive offensive. Afterward, both countries expanded reserve and engineer formations and incorporated roads, bridges, wireless communication, aviation, and equipment maintenance into military planning. Paraguay emerged in a more favorable military position, while Bolivia revised plans that relied on armor and air power for rapid victory.
dossier.result: 軍事上的直接終點是一九三五年六月十二日停火。停火通知下達後，雙方在前線舉行地方會商，開始交換俘虜並撤收部分突出陣地，其餘前線位置成為後來劃界的主要基礎，正式法律安排則延至一九三八年。二月三日，玻利維亞與巴拉圭在布宜諾斯艾利斯簽訂和平條約，約將查科地區四分之三劃給巴拉圭，玻利維亞保留北部約四分之一，並取得巴拉圭河的航行權。條約簽訂後，兩國再由軍事代表與測量人員標定陸地邊界。因此，一九三五年停火結束了實際戰鬥，一九三八年的條約則把停火時形成的控制線轉化為新的國際邊界。
dossier.resultEn: The immediate military conclusion was the ceasefire of 12 June 1935. After notifications were exchanged, the two sides held local meetings, began returning prisoners of war, and withdrew from some salient positions; the remaining forward lines became the principal basis for later demarcation, while the formal legal settlement came later. On 3 February 1938, Bolivia and Paraguay signed a peace treaty in Buenos Aires that assigned roughly three-quarters of the Chaco to Paraguay, left Bolivia about one-quarter in the north, and confirmed Bolivia’s navigation rights on the Paraguay River. Military and survey representatives subsequently established the land boundary. The 1935 ceasefire therefore ended active combat, while the 1938 treaty converted the positions arising from the truce into a new international frontier.

battle.name: 阿爾及利亞戰爭
battle.theater: 阿爾及利亞山區、沿海平原與撒哈拉
battle.brief: 阿爾及利亞戰爭（1954‑1962）為法國在北非殖民地的叛亂與游擊戰，戰場橫跨阿爾及利亞山脈、沿海平原與撒哈拉沙漠。雙方使用多樣武器，其中法軍步兵的主要步槍MAS‑36自1936年起服役，於戰爭中提供穩定的火力支援。

kit.name: MAS-36步槍
kit.history: MAS‑36是法國軍隊在二戰期間採用的標準栓式步槍，採用7.5mm口徑，於步兵班中作為主要單兵武器，提供中距離精確射擊能力。

dossier.countries: 1954年11月1日，阿爾及利亞戰爭在法國直接管轄的阿爾及利亞境內爆發。當地的交戰主體是法國共和國與法國軍隊，以及阿爾及利亞民族解放陣線所指揮的武裝組織；北非軍區橫跨阿爾及利亞本土，連接法屬北非的其他據點。法軍最初控制主要城市、海岸交通、城鎮和戰略公路，阿爾及利亞武裝則以山區、鄉村與南部邊境作為游擊基地，並在邊境取得突尼斯與摩洛哥的後勤通道。法國後來加派步兵、傘兵、外籍军团裝甲部隊、空軍與海軍部隊，並在阿爾及利亞維持軍事法庭、通信管制和情報機關。阿爾及利亞武裝則由零散的民族主義小組，逐漸統一為民族解放軍。這場戰爭的核心不是兩支在同一條戰線對峙的正規軍隊，而是法軍企圖維持殖民政體與民族解放陣線爭取政治軍事主權的長期鬥爭；1954年至1962年間，雙方的控制範圍、兵力規模與戰術都隨談判和衝突不斷變化。
dossier.countriesEn: The Algerian War began on November 1, 1954, within Algeria, which was then under the direct authority of France. The principal belligerents were the French Republic and its armed forces on one side, and the Algerian National Liberation Front and the armed organizations under its authority on the other. The North African theatre linked the Algerian interior with France’s other positions in North Africa. French troops initially held the principal cities, coastal communications, towns, and strategic roads, while Algerian fighters used mountain areas, rural districts, and the southern frontier as guerrilla bases and gained logistical access through Tunisia and Morocco. France later reinforced the theatre with infantry, paratroopers, Foreign Legion armour, air force, and naval units, while maintaining military courts, communications control, and intelligence services in Algeria. The Algerian armed groups gradually became unified as the National Liberation Army. This was not a conventional war fought by two armies along one fixed front. It was a prolonged struggle in which France attempted to preserve its colonial authority while the FLN sought political and military sovereignty. Between 1954 and 1962, control, troop strength, and tactics changed repeatedly as negotiations and armed operations continued.
dossier.people: 阿爾及利亞民族解放陣線在1954年成立時，把政治領導與武裝行動連在一起。穆罕默德·布迪亞夫、穆拉德·迪杜什、穆罕默德·拉爾比·本·邁希迪、艾哈邁德·本·貝拉與侯辛·艾特·艾哈邁德，分別在組織、宣傳、資金、游擊和後勤方面扮演重要角色，其中部分人物在1956年以前被捕，其他人物則在阿爾及利亞境外建立代表機構。法軍方面，1954年由北非最高軍事指揮系統協調作戰，勒內·韋爾等將軍先後負責清除鄉村游擊網；1956年至1958年，雅克·馬敘率領傘兵與特種部隊處理阿爾及爾市區的戰鬥。民族解放陣線後來把在阿爾及利亞內陸的民族解放軍、突尼斯和摩洛哥的訓練營、後勤站及外交代表連成一套區域性的戰爭機器。兩邊的指揮風格也不同：法軍依靠團級部隊、固定據點和空軍支援，民族解放陣線則把小隊分散給不同指揮官，使每次攻擊都與後續撤退、政治聲明及重新集結緊密相連。
dossier.peopleEn: When the Algerian National Liberation Front was formed in 1954, it linked political leadership with armed operations. Mohamed Boudiaf, Didouche Mourad, Larbi Ben M’hidi, Ahmed Ben Bella, and Hocine Aït Ahmed played important roles in organization, propaganda, financing, guerrilla activity, and logistics. Some were arrested before 1956, while others established representative offices outside Algeria. On the French side, the North African command coordinated operations in 1954, with generals such as René Vert responsible for suppressing the rural guerrilla network. From 1956 to 1958, Jacques Massu led paratroopers and special units in the urban fighting around Algiers. The FLN later connected the National Liberation Army inside Algeria with training camps, supply stations, and diplomatic offices in Tunisia and Morocco. The command styles were different. France relied on regimental units, fixed positions, and air support. The FLN dispersed small formations under different commanders and linked each attack to a withdrawal, a political statement, and subsequent regrouping.
dossier.kits: 1954年以前已列裝的裝備，決定了最初幾個月的作戰節奏。法軍使用勒貝爾Mle 1917步槍，後來配備MAS-49衝鋒槍、法國製半自動步槍，以及依據槍械種類供應的7.62毫米或7.5毫米弹药；機槍包括1914年制式霍奇基斯机枪和法制機槍，砲兵則使用75毫米野戰砲、105毫米砲和卡車牽引的火力單位。裝甲方面有M3輕戰車、M4中戰車、M5輕戰車，以及已經問世的AMX-13；裝甲偵察車有ARL-44與潘哈德EBR。空軍使用達維爾道夫式輕型運輸機、C-47空中巴士、MD-450神秘IV戰鬥轟炸機與F-86戰鬥機，另有早期Helicopter用於偵察和聯絡。阿爾及利亞武裝在1954年主要依靠步槍、輕機槍、手榴彈、地雷和小型迫擊砲；蘇聯AK-47步槍、中國56式步槍、早期RPG反戰車榴彈及75毫米迫擊砲雖較早設計或定型，卻不是開戰首日所有單位都配齊，而是後來經外部援助分批取得。
dossier.kitsEn: Equipment already in service before 1954 shaped the rhythm of the first months. French troops used Lebel Model 1917 rifles, later MAS-49 submachine guns, French semiautomatic rifles, and ammunition appropriate to each weapon, including 7.62 mm and 7.5 mm rounds. Machine guns included the Model 1914 Hotchkiss and French machine guns. Artillery included 75 mm field guns, 105 mm guns, and truck-drawn formations. Armour consisted of M3 light tanks, M4 medium tanks, M5 light tanks, and the recently introduced AMX-13, together with ARL-44 and Panhard EBR reconnaissance vehicles. The air arm used the de Havilland Dove, C-47 Skytrain, MD-450 Mystère IV fighter-bombers, F-86 fighters, and early helicopters for reconnaissance and liaison. Algerian fighters in 1954 relied mainly on rifles, light machine guns, grenades, mines, and small mortars. Soviet AK-47 rifles, Chinese Type 56 rifles, early RPG anti-tank grenades, and 75 mm mortars had been designed or adopted earlier, but they were not issued to every unit on the first day. They arrived gradually through foreign assistance.
dossier.tactics: 最初的阿爾及利亞武裝採取小規模夜間行動，先破壞通信、襲擊孤立軍車、奪取武器和设置 ambush，再迅速退回山區。法軍則逐步建立 quadrillage 網，把村鎮、道路、通信節點與巡邏隊串聯起來，並以步兵、砲兵、裝甲和空軍進行搜索；這種方法能封鎖固定目標，卻難以捕捉分散後重新編組的游擊隊。1955年後，武裝單位開始以連、排為核心，選擇山口、橋梁和公路伏擊法軍車隊，並把突擊、破壞和撤退放在同一計畫中。1956年阿爾及爾戰役改變了作戰空間，民族解放陣線以市區炸彈、狙擊、交通線襲擊和高樓射擊迫使法軍調動傘兵；法軍用特種部隊、清剿單位、封鎖線、情報網絡和軍事審判回應。1958年後，雙方都更重視外部後勤與政治代表，戰爭遂由鄉村游擊逐步轉成談判與有限正規化並行的長期衝突。
dossier.tacticsEn: The first Algerian operations were small-scale night actions. Fighters damaged communications, ambushed isolated military vehicles, seized weapons, established ambushes, and withdrew rapidly into the mountains. France progressively created a quadrillage network linking villages, roads, communications sites, and patrols. Infantry, artillery, armour, and air power were used in searches and sweeps. This system could lock down fixed targets, but it struggled to track small guerrilla groups that dispersed and reformed. After 1955, Algerian units increasingly operated as companies and platoons, choosing passes, bridges, and roads for ambushes against French convoys while integrating the assault, destruction, and withdrawal into one plan. The Algiers campaign of 1956 changed the battlefield. The FLN used urban bombings, sniping, attacks on transport routes, and fire from upper floors to force France to move paratroopers into the city. France responded with special forces, sweep units, cordons, intelligence networks, and military courts. After 1958, both sides placed greater emphasis on external logistics and political representation. Rural guerrilla warfare gradually became a prolonged conflict conducted alongside negotiations and limited conventional operations.
dossier.data: 這場戰爭的重要時間點相當清楚。1954年11月1日夜間至11月2日清晨，民族解放陣線在多個地點同時攻擊法軍設施、警察崗位、通信站和軍火庫，涉及北部、沿海和內陸多條路線；法軍在數日內恢復了城市與交通線的控制。1956年2月20日至24日召開的蘇馬姆會議，決定把武裝力量統一編入民族解放軍，並建立較完整的指揮體系。1956年至1957年的阿爾及爾戰役，使法軍投入更多傘兵和特種部隊。戰爭期間，法國兵力由開戰時約二十萬逐步增至數十萬，外籍軍團與北非部隊的統計口徑不同，因此不應把所有數字視為同一口徑。1958年9月26日戴高樂重返阿爾及利亞，政治談判與軍事清剿同時進行。1961年5月27日埃維昂談判開始，1962年3月18日簽署停火協議，19日零時起停止主要戰鬥；7月1日舉行阿爾及利亞命運公投，7月5日宣布獨立。傷亡數字因統計對象、期間和來源差異很大，本文不列未經核實的精確總數。
dossier.dataEn: The principal dates of the war are well established. During the night of November 1 and the early hours of November 2, 1954, the FLN attacked French installations, police posts, communications stations, and arsenals at several locations across northern, coastal, and inland routes. French forces regained control of the main cities and transport routes within days. The Soummam Congress, held on February 20 to 24, 1956, decided to unify the armed forces under the National Liberation Army and create a more complete command structure. The Algiers campaign of 1956 and 1957 brought additional French paratroopers and special units into the theatre. French strength rose from roughly 200,000 at the beginning of the war to several hundred thousand. Different counts of Foreign Legion and North African troops make direct comparison difficult, so the figures should not be treated as identical. Charles de Gaulle returned to Algeria on September 26, 1958, when political negotiations and military operations continued together. Evian talks began on May 27, 1961. A ceasefire agreement was signed on March 18, 1962, and major fighting ended at midnight on March 19. A referendum on Algeria’s self-determination was held on July 1, and independence was declared on July 5. Casualty estimates vary substantially by source and methodology, so no unverified precise total is given here.
dossier.cause: 戰爭的直接政治背景，是法國在1947年阿爾及利亞法令之後仍保留差別化的政治與軍事權力。該法令提供部分阿爾及利阿人的法國公民資格可能性，卻沒有讓大多數阿爾及利亞人立即取得與法國公民相同的制度地位；行政權、司法權和軍隊指揮權仍掌握在法國機關手中。1948年成立的北非之星把在法國境內的學生、工人與軍人組織連結起來，1947年以後形成的特種組織則逐步轉向武裝準備。1950年代初，法國當局逮捕並瓦解這些組織，1954年4月的革命統一與行動委員會成為新的協調核心。1954年11月1日的攻擊因此不是孤立事件，而是長期組織工作、法國鎮壓、阿爾及利亞民族主義競爭以及對主權和軍事指揮權要求的最後爆發。戰爭爆發後，外部援助與反殖民運動又把原本的法國對阿爾及利亞衝突，變成更廣泛的國際政治與軍事議題。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate political background was France’s decision, after the 1947 Algerian Statute, to retain differentiated political and military authority. The statute opened the possibility of French citizenship to some Algerians, but it did not immediately give most Algerians institutional equality with French citizens. Administrative power, judicial authority, and command of the armed forces remained in French hands. The North African Star, founded in 1948, connected students, workers, and former soldiers in France. The Special Organisation formed after 1947 gradually moved toward armed preparation. French arrests and the dismantling of these organizations intensified the confrontation, while the Revolutionary Committee for Unity and Action became the new coordinating core in April 1954. The attacks of November 1, 1954, were therefore the culmination of long-term organization, French repression, Algerian nationalism, and demands over sovereignty and military command. Once the war began, foreign assistance and anti-colonial movements transformed a bilateral French-Algerian conflict into a broader international political and military issue.
dossier.impact: 戰爭最直接的影響，是阿爾及利亞武裝從分散的游擊小組變成能夠協調多個戰區的民族解放軍。法軍在阿爾及利亞累積的經驗，後來影響了法國對其他殖民地反叛運動的部署方式，包括固定據點、空中巡邏、裝甲巡邏、情報分析與特種部隊的配合。蘇馬姆會議、民族解放陣線的統一指揮，以及突尼斯和摩洛哥的訓練與補給網，使民族主義組織獲得了更強的政治合法性。國際層面上，聯合國反覆討論阿爾及利亞問題，越南與亞洲其他反殖民衝突也讓法國承受更大的外交和軍事壓力。戰爭對法國財政造成長期負擔，並削弱法國在歐洲與北大西洋體系中的戰略彈性。對阿爾及利亞而言，1958年成立民族解放陣線臨時政府，以及後來的談判代表，使軍事勝利與國際外交逐漸結合。戰爭沒有在停火前造成任何一方的全境軍事崩潰，最後的轉折來自戰區局勢、政治組織和談判時機的共同變化。
dossier.impactEn: The most direct effect was the transformation of scattered Algerian guerrilla groups into an Algerian Liberation Army capable of coordinating several operational areas. French experience in Algeria influenced the deployment of counter-insurgency forces elsewhere, including fortified positions, aerial patrols, armoured patrols, intelligence analysis, and special units. The Soummam Congress, the FLN’s unified command, and training and supply networks in Tunisia and Morocco strengthened the political standing of the nationalist movement. At the international level, the United Nations repeatedly debated the Algerian question. The war increased diplomatic and military pressure on France, while conflicts in Vietnam and elsewhere reinforced the strategic strain on French resources. The conflict also placed a long-term burden on the French treasury and reduced France’s flexibility in Europe and the North Atlantic. For the Algerian side, the establishment of the FLN provisional government in 1958 and the later negotiating delegation brought military organization together with international diplomacy. Neither side experienced an immediate, total military collapse before the ceasefire. The eventual turning point came from the combined change in local military balance, political organization, and negotiating circumstances.
dossier.result: 談判最後轉化為停火和國家獨立，而不是法軍在戰場上被完全擊敗。1961年5月開始的埃維昂談判中，阿爾及利亞代表團由克里姆·貝爾卡塞姆等民族解放陣線人物率領，與法國政府討論軍事停火、軍隊撤出和政治過渡。1962年3月18日簽署的協議安排主要戰鬥於19日停止，法軍依協議分階段撤出大多數據點，部分軍事設施則按條款暫時保留；這表示停火並不等於所有法國軍方人員在當天完全離境。阿爾及利亞隨後舉行公投，7月5日由阿爾及利亞臨時政府宣布獨立，艾哈邁德·本·貝拉成為新國家的主要政治領導者。結果是法國承認阿爾及利亞的主權與獨立地位，民族解放陣線由起義組織轉為執政力量，而戰爭留下的邊界、軍隊安排和政治制度問題則成為新國家成立後的核心議題。就1954年至1962年的戰役而言，這個結局同時包含軍事撤退、外交承認與民族解放陣線的政治勝利。
dossier.resultEn: The war ended through negotiation, ceasefire, and independence, rather than through the complete battlefield defeat of the French army. The Evian negotiations that began in May 1961 included an Algerian delegation led by Krim Belkacem and other FLN figures. They discussed military ceasefire terms, troop withdrawal, and political transition with the French government. The agreement signed on March 18, 1962, provided for major hostilities to end on March 19. French forces withdrew in stages from most positions under the agreement, while some military facilities remained temporarily under specific provisions. The ceasefire therefore did not mean that every French military personnel member left Algerian territory immediately. A referendum followed, and on July 5 the Algerian provisional government declared independence. Ahmed Ben Bella became the principal political leader of the new state. France recognised Algerian sovereignty and independence, while the FLN changed from an insurgent organization into a governing political force. Frontier arrangements, military questions, and constitutional institutions became major issues for the new country. For the war from 1954 to 1962, the outcome combined military withdrawal, diplomatic recognition, and the FLN’s political victory.

battle.name: 第一次車臣戰爭
battle.brief: 第一次車臣戰爭於1994年末正式爆發，俄羅斯聯邦軍隊在車臣首府格洛茲尼及周邊山區展開激烈城市巷戰與游擊對抗，動員包括大量T-72主力戰車在內的裝甲單位支援步兵突破城鎮防線，並以火力掩護奪取重要據點，展現該坦克的防護與火力優勢。

kit.name: T-72主力戰車
kit.history: T-72是蘇聯於1970年代研製的主力戰車，具備120毫米滑膛炮與複合裝甲，成為俄軍機械化步兵師的核心突擊力量，至今仍在多國服役。

dossier.countries: 1994年的直接交戰方並非兩個獲國際普遍承認的國家。聯邦一方是俄羅斯聯邦；在俄羅斯的制度中，格羅茲尼是車臣共和國首府。另一方是宣布主權並以車臣共和國伊奇克里亞名義運作的杜達耶夫政府及其武裝力量。戰區位於北高加索山脈，格羅茲尼河、鐵路和南北向公路把多支縱隊壓進有限走廊。俄軍可從西部、北部、東部與南部進入，並利用達吉斯坦、印古什、斯塔夫羅波爾及銜接鐵路公路作後方；這些地區不是直接交戰方。聯邦軍在兵力、火炮和空中支援上居優勢，車臣一方則利用境內分散據點、村鎮地形與山地通道抵抗。
dossier.countriesEn: The direct belligerents in 1994 were not two broadly internationally recognized states. The federal side was the Russian Federation, within whose system Grozny was the capital of the Chechen Republic. The other side was the Dudayev government, which claimed sovereignty and operated under the name of the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria, together with its armed forces. The theater lay in the North Caucasus mountains, where the Grozny River, railway, and north-south roads compressed several columns into narrow corridors. Russian forces could enter from the west, north, east, and south while using Dagestan, Ingushetia, Stavropol, and connecting rail and road networks as rear areas; those regions were not direct belligerents. The federal force had superior strength in personnel, artillery, and air support, while the Chechen side relied on dispersed positions, village terrain, and mountain routes inside Chechnya.
dossier.people: 聯邦一端的政治授權來自總統鮑里斯·葉利欽，國防部長帕維爾·格拉喬夫承擔中央軍事責任，總參謀長阿納托利·克瓦什寧負責參謀與部隊調度，地面作戰則主要集中於羅曼·古利亞耶夫指揮的第7合約軍。前線常見部隊包括第131近衛摩步旅、第42近衛摩步師所屬第81近衛摩步團、第276摩托化步兵團及第50特種部隊旅。車臣一端由杜達耶夫掌握國家政治與戰略授權，這位前蘇聯空軍中將並非每天指揮每一支部隊；實際防務更多由國防部長阿斯蘭·馬什哈多夫及地方指揮官處理。這種差異直接影響戰役：聯邦軍能集中大量火炮與航空兵，卻難以迅速解決分散據點；車臣軍難以維持連續防線，卻能保存小單位並反覆選擇交戰地點。
dossier.peopleEn: Political authority for the federal campaign came from President Boris Yeltsin. Defense Minister Pavel Grachev bore central military responsibility, Chief of the General Staff Anatoly Kvashnin directed the staff system and force deployments, and ground operations were concentrated mainly under the 7th Combined Army commanded by Roman Gulyayev. Units commonly seen on the front included the 131st Guards Motor Rifle Brigade, the 81st Guards Motor Rifle Regiment of the 42nd Guards Motor Rifle Division, the 276th Motor Rifle Regiment, and the 50th Special Forces Brigade. On the Chechen side, Dzhokhar Dudayev held national political and strategic authority. This former Soviet Air Force lieutenant general did not personally direct every field unit day by day; practical defense was handled more often by Defense Minister Aslan Maskhadov and local commanders. That difference directly shaped the campaign: the federal force could mass artillery and aviation but struggled to eliminate dispersed positions quickly, while the Chechen force could not maintain a continuous front but could preserve small units and repeatedly choose the places of engagement.
dossier.kits: 俄軍裝備以蘇聯解體後仍可運作的標準系統為主，包括T-72B與T-80BV主戰坦克、BMP-2步兵戰鬥車、BTR-70與BTR-80裝甲運兵車及BRDM-2偵察車。火炮包括2S19 Msta-S自走式152公厘榴彈砲、2S3 Akatsiya 122公厘自走砲、BM-21 Grad火箭砲及1989年列裝的TOS-1A 130公厘突防砲；航空支援可由Su-24、Su-25、Mi-24攻擊直升機和Mi-8T運輸直升機提供。步兵裝備包括AK-74步槍、RPG-7、9M14 Ataka反裝甲飛彈，以及7.62×39公厘、5.45×39公厘和12.7公厘弹药。車臣軍則使用庫存與繳獲的AK-47、AK-74、PKM、DShK、SVD、RPG-7，以及少量T-34、T-72、BMP-1和BTR-70。數量最多的障礙不是武器名稱，而是維修、備件、駕駛訓練與不同規格弹药的供應不均。
dossier.kitsEn: Russian equipment centered on standard Soviet-era systems that remained operational after the Soviet collapse, including T-72B and T-80BV main battle tanks, BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-70 and BTR-80 armored personnel carriers, and BRDM-2 reconnaissance vehicles. Artillery included the 2S19 Msta-S 152 mm self-propelled howitzer, the 2S3 Akatsiya 122 mm self-propelled gun, the BM-21 Grad rocket artillery, and the TOS-1A 130 mm assault gun fielded in 1989. Air support could be supplied by Su-24 and Su-25 aircraft, Mi-24 attack helicopters, and Mi-8T transport helicopters. Infantry equipment included AK-74 rifles, RPG-7 launchers, 9M14 Ataka anti-tank guided missiles, and 7.62×39 mm, 5.45×39 mm, and 12.7 mm ammunition. Chechen forces used stockpiled and captured AK-47 and AK-74 rifles, PKM and DShK machine guns, SVD rifles, RPG-7 launchers, and small quantities of T-34, T-72, BMP-1, and BTR-70 vehicles. The greatest limitation was not the availability of weapon names but maintenance, spare parts, driver training, and inconsistent ammunition supply.
dossier.tactics: 12月11日的炮擊與空襲只是聯邦作戰的第一階段，真正的攻勢由多個地面縱隊展開。第131近衛摩步旅由北面經薩馬什基向阿爾漢卡拉推進；第81近衛摩步團沿塔爾斯科耶、新孫日哈一帶的鐵路與公路向格羅茲尼壓進；第276摩托化步兵團由東面巴亞尤爾特方向切入；南部部隊則沿弗拉季卡夫卡茲、別赫別赫與列丹特之間的道路和鐵路接近市區。縱隊企圖先奪取橋梁、道路交叉口和鐵路節點，再讓後續部隊展開。車臣游擊隊沒有建立完整而連續的正面，而是以反裝甲伏擊、定點遲滯、短時間集中火力及縱深撤退切斷車隊。部分俄軍坦克在前進中距步兵過遠，裝甲車內的步兵未能及時展開，長隊形因此容易在狹窄道路上停滯。進入格羅茲尼後，街道、瓦礫和樓房把縱隊切成短距離戰鬥。聯邦軍逐步改用工兵清理樓房、步兵逐棟推進、坦克在路口提供短距離直射火力，並以炮兵和航空兵支援已知火力點。1995年3月，車臣武裝在薩馬什基至阿爾漢卡拉一線反擊過度延伸的第131旅，迫使聯邦軍再次收縮。此役後，聯邦軍縮短單次推進距離，加強護衛、工兵掩護、故障車輛回收與晝夜交替的補給安排。
dossier.tacticsEn: The artillery bombardment and air attacks of December 11 were only the first phase of the federal operation; the real offensive unfolded through several ground columns. The 131st Guards Motor Rifle Brigade advanced from the north through Samashki toward Alkhan-Kala. The 81st Guards Motor Rifle Regiment pushed toward Grozny along the railway and road around Tarskoye and New Sunzha. The 276th Motor Rifle Regiment cut in from the east around Babayurt, while southern units approached along the road and railway corridor through Vladikavkaz, Bekh-Bekh, and Redant. The columns sought to seize bridges, road junctions, and railway nodes before deploying the units behind them. Chechen fighters did not establish a complete continuous front; instead, they used anti-tank ambushes, localized delays, brief concentrations of fire, and withdrawals into depth to cut the columns. Some Russian tanks moved too far ahead of their infantry, while dismounts inside armored vehicles could not deploy promptly, making long formations vulnerable to stalls on narrow roads. After entering Grozny, streets, rubble, and buildings reduced every operation to short-range fighting. Federal forces increasingly used sappers to clear structures, infantry to advance building by building, tanks to provide direct fire at intersections, and artillery and aviation to support identified strongpoints. In March 1995, Chechen fighters counterattacked the overextended 131st Brigade along the Samashki to Alkhan-Kala line and forced federal units to contract again. The federal command subsequently shortened individual advances and strengthened convoy escorts, engineer cover, vehicle recovery, and alternating day-and-night resupply.
dossier.data: 關鍵日期構成了一條清楚的戰役時間線。杜達耶夫於1994年10月11日當選車臣總統；12月初，車臣武裝力量在格羅茲尼控制聯邦機構並扣押代表，使莫斯科把局勢判定為國家緊急狀態。俄羅斯國家杜馬在12月7日完成使用武力的授權，葉利欽於12月9日至10日簽署命令，聯邦炮兵與航空兵在12月11日開始攻擊。第81近衛摩步團約在12月17日控制新孫日哈，12月28日前後取得格羅茲尼火車站並逐步控制機場，12月29日至31日先頭部隊進入市中心。總統府在1995年1月4日被聯邦軍攻占，1月6日聯邦旗幟升上市中心廣場，但戰鬥沒有當日結束。1995年3月9日至31日，薩馬什基至阿爾漢卡拉一線爆發第二次薩馬什基戰鬥；4月21日，杜達耶夫在漢卡拉附近的直升機事故後身亡；8月6日，議會選舉馬什哈多夫為總統。城市主要戰術行動延續至1995年盛夏，聯邦軍其後以控制市中心、交通線和大型建築物為主。聯邦軍於1996年1月7日開始分批撤出格羅茲尼，至3月底完成主要撤離；12月12日簽署的哈薩維尤爾特協議則為政治與軍事衝突設定了停火框架。首批聯邦部署常被估為約三萬至四萬人，坦克、步兵戰鬥車與裝甲運兵車合計達數百輛，但各團番轉、封存單位與後續增援使實際數字持續變動。後勤以公路和鐵路為主，炮兵使用122公厘、152公厘、120公厘迫擊砲與TOS-1A榴彈，航空兵補充制導與非制導炸彈。冬季結冰、山路狹窄、受損車輛和游擊隊襲擾使油料、備件、輪胎與回收設備成為補給瓶頸；進入城市後，火車站和市中心補給點更處於直接火力之下。
dossier.dataEn: The key dates form a clear operational timeline. Dudayev was elected president of Chechnya on October 11, 1994. In early December, Chechen armed forces took control of federal facilities in Grozny and detained representatives, leading Moscow to classify the situation as a state of emergency. The Russian State Duma completed its authorization for the use of force on December 7, and Yeltsin signed the order on December 9 to 10. Federal artillery and aviation began attacking on December 11. The 81st Guards Motor Rifle Regiment controlled New Sunzha around December 17, seized the Grozny railway station and gradually took control of the airport around December 28, and advanced into the city center from December 29 to 31. The Presidential Palace was stormed by federal troops on January 4, 1995, and the federal flag was raised over the central square on January 6, but the fighting did not end that day. The second Battle of Samashki, along the Samashki to Alkhan-Kala line, ran from March 9 to 31, 1995. Dudayev died following a helicopter accident near Khankala on April 21, and parliament elected Maskhadov president on August 6. Major urban operations continued through the summer of 1995, after which federal control concentrated on the city center, transport lines, and major buildings. Federal troops began withdrawing from Grozny in stages on January 7, 1996, completing the main withdrawal by the end of March. The Khasavyurt Agreement signed on December 12 then established a framework for ending the political and military conflict. The initial federal deployment is commonly estimated at roughly 30,000 to 40,000 personnel and several hundred tanks, infantry fighting vehicles, and armored personnel carriers, but unit rotations, stored formations, and later reinforcements continually changed the actual figure. Logistics depended primarily on roads and railways. Artillery used 122 mm and 152 mm rounds, 120 mm mortar ammunition, and TOS-1A shells, while aviation added guided and unguided bombs. Winter ice, narrow mountain roads, disabled vehicles, and guerrilla interference made fuel, spare parts, tires, and recovery equipment major bottlenecks. Once forces entered the city, the railway station and central depots were also under direct fire.
dossier.cause: 戰爭的直接背景是蘇聯解體後留下的主權與權力問題。車臣在1991年11月宣布主權，俄羅斯聯邦則拒絕承認其脫離聯邦地位；此後數年間，格羅茲尼的行政機構、武装組織和安全命令逐漸並存。1994年10月杜達耶夫當選，使車臣政府取得更完整的國內政治授權，並進一步拒絕接受俄羅斯聯邦中央對其軍隊與政府的全面指揮。莫斯科擔心車臣的武裝化與其他北高加索衝突相互連結，會使聯邦權威出現無法逆轉的缺口；車臣政府則把俄軍集結視為推翻現有政府的準備。12月初的格羅茲尼武裝突擊和聯邦機構被扣成為立即導火線。杜馬授權與葉利欽簽署命令後，莫斯科已決定以軍事手段解除武裝、恢復聯邦控制；車臣方面則選擇抵抗而非解散政府與軍隊。最初開火雖由俄羅斯發動，但其前方已累積了數年的憲法衝突、軍事集結和相互不承認。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate background was the unresolved question of sovereignty and authority left by the collapse of the Soviet Union. Chechnya declared sovereignty in November 1991, while the Russian Federation refused to recognize its separation from the federation. Over the following years, Grozny developed parallel administrative institutions, armed organizations, and security commands. Dudayev's election in October 1994 gave the Chechen government stronger domestic political legitimacy and further confirmed its rejection of full control by the Russian federal center. Moscow feared that the armed organization of Chechnya, together with links to other conflicts in the North Caucasus, would create an irreversible break in federal authority. The Chechen government regarded the Russian troop buildup as preparation for the removal of its government. The armed seizure of federal facilities and the detention of representatives in Grozny in early December served as the immediate trigger. After the Duma authorization and Yeltsin's order, Moscow had chosen military means to disarm the opposition and restore federal control; the Chechen side chose resistance rather than dissolving its government and armed forces. Although Russia fired the first shots, the invasion came after years of constitutional conflict, military concentration, and mutual nonrecognition.
dossier.impact: 戰役首先改變了格羅茲尼的物理與軍事面貌。總統府、政府機關、火車站、工業設施和道路網受到嚴重破壞，原本作為聯邦象徵的首都變成難以維持行政運作的戰場。軍事上，俄軍集中坦克、由裝甲車輸送步兵的做法在鄉村公路和城市街道都受到考驗；炮兵與航空兵能壓制已知陣地，卻難以持續追蹤迅速移動的小單位。聯邦軍後來加強工兵與步兵配合，縮短裝甲縱隊前進距離，並把封鎖、控制交通線和穩定補給放在單純追求市區面積之前。車臣軍在格羅茲尼失去大量固定陣地與重裝備，但分散小單位及其指揮關係仍然延續，杜達耶夫在四多月後身亡，馬什哈多夫則接掌政治與軍事領導。雙方傷亡均十分重大，官方公報、後來研究與不同機構統計相差很大，因此沒有可信的單一精確總數。戰役沒有形成穩定政治和解，反而使聯邦軍在國內承受增加壓力，也讓車臣武裝獲得延續其軍事體系的經驗。
dossier.impactEn: The campaign first transformed the physical and military character of Grozny. The Presidential Palace, government offices, railway station, industrial installations, and road network were heavily damaged, turning a capital that had served as a federal symbol into a battlefield where administrative operations were extremely difficult to sustain. Militarily, Russian reliance on concentrated tanks and infantry transported in armored vehicles was tested on both rural roads and urban streets. Artillery and aviation could suppress identified positions but struggled to track small units that moved rapidly. Federal forces consequently strengthened engineer and infantry coordination, shortened armored advances, and placed greater emphasis on blocking routes, controlling transport lines, and stabilizing supply rather than merely occupying additional blocks of the city. Chechen forces lost many fixed positions and much heavy equipment in Grozny, but dispersed units and their command relationships survived. Dudayev died more than four months later, while Maskhadov took over political and military leadership. Both sides suffered substantial losses, but official reports, later studies, and figures from different organizations vary greatly, so there is no reliable single exact total. The campaign did not produce a stable political settlement. Instead, it increased domestic pressure on the federal government to set a withdrawal timetable and allowed the Chechen armed forces to gain the experience needed to preserve their military structure.
dossier.result: 聯邦軍在1994年12月底進入格羅茲尼，於1995年1月4日攻占總統府、1月6日控制市中心象徵性地完成奪取首都的目標，但城市並未立即平靜。第131旅在1995年3月薩馬什基的失利顯示，聯邦軍即使取得戰術突破口，也可能因前線過長而失去已占據據點。經過後續清剿與封鎖，聯邦軍在1995年盛夏控制了火車站、機場、政府區和多數主要交通走廊，車臣最高指揮體系則在市中心之外繼續運作。這是一個局部軍事成功而非決定性勝負：俄軍未能摧毀車臣的整個領導與武裝體系，車臣一方也未能以軍事手段迫使聯邦軍永久離開。1996年1月至3月的分批撤退結束了聯邦軍對格羅茲尼的實地占領；同年12月12日簽署的哈薩維尤爾特協議要求俄軍完成撤出並禁止俄羅斯武裝力量留在車臣，卻沒有解決車臣的最終政治地位。主要軍事行動通常以1995年8月大規模攻勢收束為界，政治與軍事上的結束則落在1996年的撤軍和停火安排。戰爭留下的實際狀態，是聯邦法律地位與車臣實地控制同時存在、邊界與權力未獲永久解決的分裂局面。
dossier.resultEn: Federal forces entered Grozny at the end of December 1994, captured the Presidential Palace on January 4, 1995, and symbolically completed the objective of taking the capital center when they raised their flag on January 6, but the city did not immediately become secure. The setback suffered by the 131st Brigade at Samashki in March 1995 showed that even when federal forces achieved a tactical breach, they could lose positions already occupied through an overextended front. After subsequent clearing operations and blockades, federal troops controlled the railway station, airport, government district, and most major transport corridors by the summer of 1995, while the Chechen high command continued to operate outside the city center. This represented a limited military success rather than a decisive victory. Russia did not destroy the Chechen command structure and armed forces as a whole, while Chechnya did not force the federal military to leave permanently. The phased withdrawal from January through March 1996 ended federal physical occupation of Grozny. The Khasavyurt Agreement signed on December 12, 1996 required the Russian withdrawal to be completed and prohibited Russian armed forces from remaining in Chechnya, but it did not settle Chechnya's final political status. The main military phase is conventionally dated to the tapering of the large offensive around August 1995, while the political and military termination came through the withdrawal and ceasefire arrangements of 1996. The result was a divided situation in which the federal legal position and Chechen territorial control both persisted, with no permanent settlement of borders or authority.

battle.name: 第二次義埃戰爭
battle.theater: 東非高原、厄立特里亞與意屬索馬里
battle.brief: 第二次義埃戰爭於1935年10月爆發，義大利以現代化的航空兵力和機械化步兵向衣索比亞的高原推進。義軍裝備的菲亞特B.R.20轟炸機於1935年正式服役，承擔轟炸與偵察任務，支援地面行動。

kit.name: 菲亞特B.R.20轟炸機
kit.history: 菲亞特B.R.20是義大利空軍在1930年代中期引進的雙發動機中型轟炸機，隸屬於轟炸航空團，主要負責對敵方縱深目標的轟炸與戰術支援。

battle.name: 第一次蘇丹內戰
battle.brief: 第一次蘇丹內戰於1955年8月爆發，政府軍與南方叛軍在蘇丹南部及中部展開激烈交火。衝突期間，蘇丹政府軍部署了美國製造的M3斯圖亞特輕型坦克，該坦克於1941年正式服役，具備良好機動性與火力支援。

kit.name: M3 斯圖亞特輕型坦克
kit.history: M3 Stuart為二戰期間廣泛使用的輕型坦克，具備高速機動與可靠火力，主要用於偵察、快速突破及支援步兵，是美國裝甲兵力的骨幹之一。

battle.name: 越南戰爭
battle.brief: 越南戰爭自1959年起在東南亞熱帶丛林展開，美國與北越正規軍及游擊隊的衝突升級。雙方广泛使用包括UH-1「休伊」直升機在內的多型軍備，UH-1在兵力投送與近距離空中支援中扮演關鍵角色，提升了地面部隊的機動性與火力。

kit.name: UH-1「休伊」直升機
kit.history: UH-1為美軍首款大批量使用的戰術通用直升機，主要負責兵員與物資運輸、空中偵察及近距離支援任務，並成為越戰標誌性空中平台。

battle.name: 剛果危機
battle.brief: 1960年，比利時殖民的剛果共和國宣告獨立後旋即陷入內戰與分離主義危機，導致卡斯特斯省政府、沖突各省及聯合國維和介入，局勢動盪至1965年。此危機中使用的標準步槍之一即為美國於1959年服役的M14自動步槍。

kit.name: M14自動步槍
kit.history: M14自動步槍是美軍在冷戰期間採用的標準步槍，取代M1伽蘭德，發射7.62×51mm北約彈，具備半自動與全自動射擊模式，並被多國軍隊採用。

battle.name: 安哥拉獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 安哥拉（葡萄牙殖民時期）
battle.brief: 安哥拉獨立戰爭於1961年2月正式爆發，葡萄牙殖民軍與安哥拉民族解放組織在城鄉及叢林展開激烈衝突。雙方均大量配備蘇聯製造的AK-47自動步槍，該武器以其堅固可靠著稱，在游擊戰中發揮關鍵作用。

kit.name: AK-47自動步槍
kit.history: AK-47是蘇聯於1947年研製的5.45×39mm口徑自動步槍，以可靠性聞名，成為華約及多國游擊隊的主要步兵武器。

items.id: 1998-埃塞俄比亞-厄立特里亞戰爭

battle.name: 埃塞俄比亞-厄立特里亞戰爭
battle.brief: 1998年5月，埃塞俄比亞與厄立特里亞因邊界爭端在巴德梅地區爆發武裝衝突，雙方動員大量正規軍與重裝備，展開激烈的地面與空中對抗。這場戰爭的焦點之一是埃塞軍的T-55主力戰車，其在蘇聯時期大量裝備，並在衝突中發揮重要作用。

kit.name: T-55主力戰車
kit.history: T-55是蘇聯第二代中型戰車，設計用於提供可靠的火力與裝甲支援，於冷戰期間大量裝備蘇聯及受援國家，成為地面部隊的主力裝甲平台。

battle.name: 第二次印巴戰爭
battle.theater: 克什米爾與旁遮普前線
battle.brief: 第二次印巴戰爭（1965年）爆發於克什米爾與旁遮普，雙方投入大量機械化兵團。巴基斯坦陸軍在這場衝突中使用了美製M4A1雪曼坦克，該坦克早於1942年服役，並在戰爭中提供重要裝甲支援。

kit.name: M4A1雪曼坦克
kit.history: M4A1雪曼坦克是二戰期間美國主力中型坦克，後來退役或轉讓至盟友，1965年巴基斯坦軍隊在印巴戰爭中將其作為裝甲突擊骨幹使用。

battle.name: 奈及利亞內戰
battle.brief: 奈及利亞內戰於一九六七年七月在聯邦政府軍與比亞法拉軍隊之間展開，戰事集中於奈及利亞東部。比亞法拉軍隊使用蘇製AK-47突擊步槍；該正式型號已於一九四九年列裝，是其步兵部隊的重要地面武器，最終戰局由聯邦政府軍取得勝利。

kit.name: 卡莫夫突擊步槍
kit.history: AK-47是蘇聯制式突擊步槍，隸屬步兵分隊的輕武器系統，擔任班與排的自動射擊火力，位階低於通用機槍與火炮。

battle.name: 第三次中東戰爭
battle.brief: 第三次中東戰爭於1967年6月爆發，以色列與埃及、敘利亞等國在中東戰線交鋒；戰事主要發生在西奈半島、戈蘭高地及約旦邊境一帶。戰役中，以軍裝甲部隊使用美製M48巴頓坦克，負責正面突破、裝甲支援、占領要地，並與步兵協同作戰。

kit.name: 巴頓中型坦克
kit.history: M48是美國陸軍二戰後標準中型坦克體系的正式型號，擔任裝甲營主力，負責以主砲支援步兵、對抗裝甲目標並在機動作戰中推進占領。

battle.name: 中蘇邊界衝突
battle.brief: 維基戰爭列表所列的中蘇邊界衝突，於一九六九年三月在黑龍江省珍寶島地區爆發武裝交火，中國邊防部隊出動59式中型坦克巡邏並阻擋蘇軍裝甲車隊。這場衝突是雙方在邊界地區長期對峙的一次直接碰撞，亦成為後續邊防警戒升高的背景。

kit.name: 59式中型坦克
kit.history: 59式中型坦克是中國人民解放軍陸軍裝甲兵的第一款國產中型主戰坦克，承擔正面突擊與裝甲支援任務，是當時陸軍機械化部隊的重要骨幹。

battle.name: 孟加拉國解放戰爭
battle.brief: 孟加拉國解放戰爭於一九七一年爆發，東巴基斯坦軍政府鎮壓獨立運動後，印巴軍隊在孟加拉地區交戰。巴基斯坦空軍在戰事中曾運用F-86F噴氣戰鬥機執行攔截、巡邏與對地任務。衝突由三月軍事行動延續至年末，最終以孟加拉國獨立告終，並改變南亞政治格局。

kit.name: F-86F佩刀式戰鬥機
kit.history: F-86F是美國空軍早期單座後掠翼噴氣戰鬥機，憑高速性能與俯衝能力擔任制空、攔截及對地支援，主要編入空軍戰鬥機聯隊。
